jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations Manager

💰 £50,000 to £60,000 depending on experience

📍 Salary based on London. Two days a week in the office, the rest remote.

 

Fanvue is one of the fastest-growing creator monetisation platforms globally. We're an AI-powered, creator-first platform helping creators connect, engage, and earn directly from their audiences at scale. Following our recent Series A, Fanvue has surpassed $100M+ in annual recurring revenue, with triple-digit year-on-year growth, supporting hundreds of thousands of creators and millions of fans worldwide.

Business Operations keeps money moving correctly, keeps the platform safe, and keeps us on the right side of our banking, payment and regulatory relationships. It covers payments and payout infrastructure, treasury, verification and KYC, fraud and risk, Trust and Safety, compliance, and the data work underneath all of it. Most of that surface is currently held by a small number of very senior people. This role exists to work alongside them across all of it.

 

🎯 The Role

 

We're hiring an Operations Manager to sit at the centre of Business Operations, reporting to our Chief Business Operations Officer and working closely with our Senior Operations Manager.

This is deliberately a broad role, and we want to be straight about what that means. You will not have one fixed remit. You will be pointed at whatever the most important operational problem is that week, and expected to pick it up, work out what is actually going on, and drive it to a conclusion. Some weeks that is building out system flows. Some weeks it is a number that does not reconcile, a live incident, or a compliance pack that has to be right by end of day.

You will be taught directly by the CBOO, not handed a wiki. You will have data warehouse and provider system access from your first week. Success in month one is not output, it is that you understand how money moves through the business and have started closing things out without being chased.

You will start broad and stay broad for a while. Over time we will shape your work towards whichever areas suit you, with the intent that you eventually own one properly, with a remit and in time a team.

 

🚀 What You'll Do

  • Take on whatever is most urgent: ambiguous, half-understood problems that need the facts established and the loop closed

  • Run the operational side of our payment, payout, verification and risk provider relationships, from stuck tickets to due diligence packs

  • Reconcile what our providers say happened against what our systems say happened, and chase down every difference until it is explained

  • Investigate risk and fraud alongside the fraud team, and propose the controls that close the gaps

  • Support live incidents involving money or user safety, running the analysis and owning the follow-up

  • Write it all down: runbooks, process docs, control documentation, post-incident reviews

 
 

👀 Who You Are

  • Someone who moves on their own initiative. When you hit a wall, your instinct is to find the way round it rather than report it

  • Someone who finishes things reliably, without being chased, including the boring parts

  • Comfortable with numbers. You can pull data, check it against a second source, and notice when something does not add up

  • A clear writer. Muddled writing usually means muddled thinking

  • Intellectually honest. You separate what you have verified from what you are assuming, and say when you do not know

  • Someone who gets more careful under pressure, not less

  • Someone who wants direct, frequent feedback

  • Roughly 1 to 3 years in anything that demanded accuracy and independent thinking: operations, finance, consulting, analytics, support, or a startup where you did a bit of everything

  • Fintech or payments operations exposure is a strong plus. You do not need payments, KYC or compliance experience, management experience despite the title, or SQL on day one

  • Unconventional career paths welcome, if you can explain why yours prepared you for this

 
 

✨ You'll Thrive Here If

Lean Manufacturing Engineer

Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

As our manufacturing moves from R&D and low-volume production toward structured, scalable industrial output, we're looking for a hands-on Lean engineer who combines strong analytical skills with a pragmatic shop-floor mindset. You'll adapt Lean intelligently to a complex high-tech environment (long cycle times, expensive equipment, cleanroom and yield constraints) and help us manufacture faster, more reliably and at greater scale, without compromising quality or innovation. 

Your Key Resonsabilities

  • Define and deploy Lean principles across our semiconductor, photonic and system manufacturing, adapting them intelligently to a complex, low-volume/high-mix environment 
  • Map end-to-end flows with Value Stream Mapping, define current and future states, and build improvement roadmaps based on real constraints
  • Analyze cycle time at product, workshop and process-step level, separating processing, queue, waiting, transport and test times, and lead actions to reduce lead time and WIP 
  • Introduce pull-flow or controlled-WIP principles where relevant and improve flow between workshops and production stages
  • Identify bottlenecks, analyze equipment loading and capacity losses, and optimize sequencing around constrained equipment 
  • Implement and improve OEE monitoring on critical equipment, analyze availability, performance and quality losses, and support preventive maintenance and TPM initiatives
  • Develop standardized work with Methods and Production to reduce variability between operators and runs 
  • Build shop-floor and visual management systems (safety, quality, delivery, cost, WIP) with daily routines and escalation mechanisms
  • Lead structured problem solving (PDCA, DMAIC, 5 Why, Ishikawa, Pareto, Kaizen) and build these capabilities within production teams 
  • Deploy and sustain 5S, including in cleanroom environments, while respecting contamination-control and safety requirements
  • Work with Process Engineering and Quality to reduce scrap, rework and yield losses without compromising process robustness 
  • Identify cost-reduction opportunities, build business cases for Lean projects and track actual savings
  • Embed Lean into new production lines, layouts and equipment investments, so scale-up doesn't replicate today's inefficiencies at a larger scale 

Requirements

  • Engineering degree or Master's in Industrial, Manufacturing or Operations Engineering, or a related technical field 
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Manufacturing Engineering or Continuous Improvement
  • Proven track record of improving manufacturing performance 
  • Hands-on expertise in VSM, Standardized Work, 5S, OEE, and cycle-time and WIP reduction
  • Strong data-driven, analytical mindset 
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive change
  • Fluent French and professional English 

Nice to have

  •  Experience in semiconductors, photonics, cleanroom or wafer fab, industrial scale-up, SPC, or ERP/MES environments; Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan

  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

jobs.description:
RWE Delivery Manager - France/Germany

🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimize patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring, and in-depth analysis of real-world data. Today, our solutions are deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across more than 200 healthcare facilities, as well as within the framework of around twenty academic and industrial clinical trials.

Through this, we put data at the service of healthcare and therapeutic innovation, driven by the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine.

📝 Your Role

In a few words: you will lead the end-to-end delivery of Real-World Evidence (RWE) studies in Germany & France, connecting clinical research, remote monitoring and health data. You will own execution: timelines, budgets, site and partner coordination, deliverable quality and the sponsor relationship.

Your impact: make studies work in practice and generate reliable evidence for oncology and haematology research. The site relationships, methods and tools you build should also make future studies easier to deliver.

Your day to day:

  • Lead studies from contracting to the final report, including protocol and statistical analysis plan coordination, ethics submissions, data collection and deliverables.

  • Maintain an actionable project timeline, anticipate risks and propose solutions before milestones are affected.

  • Track study budgets, committed expenditure, site costs and clinical research organisation (CRO) costs.

  • Select and activate sites with local teams, coordinate site contracting and oversee CRO partners.

  • Act as the sponsor’s primary operational contact and lead steering committees with international pharmaceutical partners.

  • Work with Medical, Clinical Operations, Data, Legal and Quality teams, and turn delivery experience into reusable methods.

    • you’ll work closely with Mehdi, Project Manager RWE, on study delivery and shared project-management practices, and with Maxime and Eugénie, Global Pharma Partners, to connect pharmaceutical partners’ needs with practical study execution.

  • Your manager:

    • you’ll report to Adil, RWE Lead, who leads Resilience’s Real-World Evidence activities. Adil gives you room to own your projects, with clear priorities and support when decisions need to be made. He values early communication, practical solutions and following through on commitments.

  • The little ➕ about your team:

    • when the Life Sciences team gets together, Italian food is our go-to, a small tradition we’re happy to share with new colleagues.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Lead a clinical or non-interventional study end to end, understanding the dependencies between each stage.

  • Navigate the German research environment: ethics committees, GDPR/DSGVO, Länder-level data protection requirements and hospital contracting.

  • Oversee a CRO and its deliverables, with a clear understanding of sponsor responsibilities, pharmacovigilance and monitoring plans.

  • Track a study budget and make variances, risks and necessary trade-offs visible.

  • Assess clinical data quality and discuss electronic health record structuring and AI-assisted extraction.

  • Work fluently in German and use professional English in writing and speaking.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • A strong sense of ownership: you follow work through to results rather than stopping at coordination.

  • Structured working habits that leave room for anticipation and process improvement.

  • The reflex to flag risks early, alongside a proposed course of action.

  • Clear communication with scientific, operational and commercial stakeholders.

  • Composure when plans change and autonomy in an international, distributed setting.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Managed clinical or non-interventional studies with direct responsibility for timelines and deliverables.

  • Worked with investigator sites and research partners in the German ecosystem.

  • Overseen a CRO from the sponsor side.

  • Tracked research project costs and budgets.

  • Coordinated cross-functional teams and presented project progress to a sponsor or pharmaceutical partners.

It’s a plus if you have delivered studies in oncology or haematology.

💛 Why join us?

  • Contribute to research grounded in real care pathways, working with sites and medical teams.

  • Lead studies that combine remote monitoring, patient-reported outcomes and clinical data.

  • Own projects end to end, with responsibility for execution and results.

  • Build lasting methods and partnerships with an international, multidisciplinary team.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Screening with Elena - 15 min: discuss your motivation and the role’s prerequisites.

  2. Manager Fit with Adill - 30min: to dive deeper into your background and product vision

  3. Case Study with Adil, and members of Team Medic — Format: a business case sent a few days in advance, followed by a live presentation and Q&A.

  4. Team Fit with Mehdi, Eugénie, Ivan, Daniel, Sebastien — 30 min/itw : collaboration fit

  • Maintain accurate deferred revenue balances

  • Calculate and review provisions

  • Prepare and review AR and deferred revenue roll-forwards, journal entries and supporting schedules

Global Service Center Supply Chain & Inventory Engineer

Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre enjeu : faire de la Supply Chain un levier de performance durable pour l'ensemble des Service Centers.

Rattaché.e au Global Service Center Manager, vous êtes référent métier Supply Chain & Inventory à l'échelle globale. Vous garantissez la fiabilité, la performance et l'harmonisation des processus, des outils et des pratiques au sein du réseau de Service Centers (SAV Robotique). Vous êtes également responsable de la disponibilité des pièces, de la maîtrise des stocks et de leur optimisation afin de soutenir les objectifs de performance opérationnelle et financière.

Missions :

Gérer les approvisionnements et les stocks à l’échelle globale

  • Superviser les flux critiques de planification et d'approvisionnement afin de garantir la disponibilité des pièces.
  • Valider les propositions d'ordres de transfert et suivre les encours critiques.
  • Définir et piloter les processus de Demand Planning et de réapprovisionnement afin d'assurer la cohérence entre prévisions, besoins opérationnels et niveaux de stock.
  • Être force de proposition sur les stratégies d'approvisionnement et d'optimisation des stocks.
  • Garantir la disponibilité des pièces tout en maîtrisant les coûts associés et les niveaux d'inventaire.
  • Piloter les actions de réduction des stocks dormants et obsolètes.
  • Définir les stratégies de gestion du cycle de vie des pièces et de prévention de l'obsolescence.
  • Définir les standards de performance logistique et accompagner les équipes locales dans le suivi des partenaires transport.
  • Soutenir les équipes locales dans la résolution des situations complexes.

Développer l’excellence opérationnelle Supply Chain

  • Garantir la cohérence, l'efficacité et la performance des processus Supply Chain au sein de l'ensemble des Service Centers.
  • Définir, formaliser et déployer les standards métiers en matière de Supply Chain, de gestion des stocks et de planification.
  • Animer les démarches d'amélioration continue des pratiques logistiques, d'approvisionnement et de gestion des stocks.
  • Identifier les écarts de performance, analyser leurs causes racines et piloter les plans d'actions associés.
  • Promouvoir le partage des bonnes pratiques et le retour d'expérience entre les différentes régions.

Être le référent des outils et systèmes

  • Agir en tant que Super Key User des outils Supply Chain, Inventory et Logistique (SAP, DDMRP, Power BI et outils associés).
  • Assurer le paramétrage métier, la cohérence des données de référence et le respect des standards de gestion.
  • Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption et l'utilisation optimale des outils.
  • Développer et maintenir les supports de formation ainsi que la documentation métier.
  • Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap fonctionnelle des outils en collaboration avec les équipes IT, Data et métiers.
  • Identifier les opportunités de digitalisation et d'automatisation des processus Supply Chain.

Piloter la performance Supply Chain

  • Être garant de l'atteinte des objectifs mondiaux de disponibilité des pièces, de valeur de stock, de rotation des stocks et de réduction des stocks obsolètes.
  • Animer les revues de performance Supply Chain avec les différentes régions et assurer le suivi des plans d'actions associés.
  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) Supply Chain.
  • Faire évoluer les tableaux de bord et outils de pilotage en collaboration avec les équipes Data.
  • Analyser les tendances, identifier les risques opérationnels et les opportunités d'amélioration.
  • Proposer et piloter les actions correctives permettant d'améliorer la disponibilité des pièces, le niveau de service et la maîtrise des stocks.
  • Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du management.

Piloter les projets stratégiques Supply Chain

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux projets structurants liés aux processus, aux outils, à la gestion des stocks et à l'organisation logistique.
  • Coordonner le déploiement de nouvelles solutions, méthodologies et évolutions systèmes.
  • Participer aux projets de transformation majeurs (ERP, hubs logistiques, optimisation des stocks, Demand Planning, digitalisation des processus, etc.).
  • Assurer l'alignement entre les besoins opérationnels des Service Centers et les objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise.
  • Mesurer les bénéfices des projets déployés et garantir l'atteinte des résultats attendus.

Profil :

  • Diplôme d'ingénieur.e ou formation équivalente en Supply Chain, Logistique ou Génie Industriel.
  • Minimum 4 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions Supply Chain, approvisionnement, planification ou gestion des stocks avec une forte dimension opérationnelle et projet, dans un environnement international (idéalement multisites)
  • Excellente maîtrise des processus Supply Chain et de gestion des stocks.
  • Bonne connaissance des principes de Demand Planning, Forecasting et Inventory Management.
  • Bonne connaissance de SAP.
  • Maîtrise avancée d'Excel, Power BI et des outils d'analyse de données (BigQuery apprécié).
  • Connaissance Solide des méthodologies Lean et d'amélioration continue appréciée.

Benefits

  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Why this role matters at Pennylane

Within our “track-based” organization, the Core Accounting team sits at the heart of our product value proposition: reliability, efficiency, and automation of day-to-day accounting operations. Working directly with the Head of Product for the track, the Senior Strategy & Operations role brings the structure, cadence, and operational standards needed to turn priorities into clear, measurable, and scalable execution within a context of growing complexity (multiple stakeholders, fast trade-offs, monetization topics).

Data-driven decision making

  • Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

  • Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

  • Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

  • Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

  • Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Laura - Head of Product Core Accounting (1h)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern

Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

  • Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

  • Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

  • Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

Read this first — two non-negotiables

Still with us? Great — here's why this role is worth your attention.

Who we are

We're Jobtome (https://weare.jobtome.com/) — an HR Tech company building the modern web applications that companies use to run complex hiring and recruitment workflows at scale.

Our products are highly interactive, data-driven, and built for real-world usage — not demos. We work with a strong product mindset, short feedback loops, and a pragmatic engineering culture: quality, ownership, and code we're still proud of a year from now.

The role

You'll join our engineering team as a Senior Go Backend Developer and take real ownership of critical backend systems and services — not ticket-pushing, actual ownership.

You'll design, build, and evolve the backend services that power our products, weigh in on architectural decisions, improve system reliability, and help shape how backend engineering is done across the company.

This is a hands-on senior role: you'll write production Go every day and be deeply involved in technical decisions that have real impact.


Quick reminder before the details

5+ years of production Go experience — required Based in a European timezone (UTC−1 to UTC+3)

What you'll do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services written in Go

  • Build and evolve APIs (GraphQL and/or REST) behind complex product workflows

  • Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend architectures

  • Work closely with frontend engineers, product managers, data engineers, and designers

  • Contribute to data modeling, business logic, and performance optimization

  • Review code and take part in architectural and technical discussions

  • Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, and system resilience

  • Actively tackle refactoring, technical debt, and long-term improvements

  • Own backend features end to end, from design to production

  • Take part in Agile ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, retrospectives)

Our stack

Go sits at the center of everything. Around it, you'll work with (and should be comfortable with):

  • API design (GraphQL and/or REST)

  • PostgreSQL (or similar relational databases)

  • BigQuery and other NoSQL databases

  • Distributed systems and service-oriented architectures

  • Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab pipelines preferred)

  • A cloud-infrastructure mindset (GCP or other providers)

  • Observability tools (logging, metrics, tracing)

  • Testing (unit and/or integration)

  • Kubernetes

Nice to have:

  • Working experience with Python

  • Exposure to Protobuf and gRPC

What "senior" means to us

Titles vary — here's what we actually mean. A senior engineer at Jobtome can:

  • Work independently without needing perfect specs

  • Own complex features and systems

  • Make informed architectural decisions and explain the trade-offs

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-structured code

  • Spot problems early and propose solutions

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical people alike

How we work

jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer - Tracker
jobs.description:
Computer Vision Engineer - Tracker

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Computer Vision Engineer in the Computer Vision Tracker team, you will join us at a very early stage, giving you a unique opportunity to heavily influence the technical direction of the team. Operating out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will focus on creating a global 3D Object Tracking pipeline, at the intersection between the Computer Vision, Sensor Fusion and GNC teams.

 

Responsibilities

  • Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.

  • Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

  • Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.

  • Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Mathematics).

  • Embedded Algorithmic Expertise: Proven track record in the research, development, and productization of Computer Vision & Sensor-Fusion algorithms in hardware-constrained environments.

  • Technical Competence: Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for real-time systems. Experience with optimizing code for edge deployment.

 

Nice to have

  • Highly structured, analytical, task-aligned, and research-oriented.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to effectively translate and present complex algorithmic trade-offs to downstream users and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality toward building foundational team infrastructure.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams.

You will:

  • Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions.

  • Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members.

  • Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues).

  • Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency.

  • Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing.

jobs.title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
Who we are and what you’ll do

HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.


Main objectives of the role

As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.


Your role and responsibilities

  • Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.

  • Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel

  • High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.

  • Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.

  • Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.

  • AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

  • Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments

  • Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.

  • Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.

  • AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.

  • Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

jobs.title: Neuroscientist
jobs.description:
Neuroscientist

Type: Full-time
Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site

The Role

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording

  • Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

  • Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

  • Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design

  • Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

  • Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

  • Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling

  • Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

  • Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics

  • Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team

Neuroscience → AI Translation

  • Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices

  • Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

  • Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements

Core (essential)

  • BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience.

  • Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments

  • Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

  • Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

  • Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

Valued (or willing to learn)

  • Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets

  • Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training

  • Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data

  • Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research

jobs.description:
Director Global Logistics

About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is scaling its industrial footprint across France, Morocco, the United States and future production locations. We are looking for a Director Global Logistics to build and lead the logistics function supporting this growth.

The role owns the movement of finished products from shipment readiness through customer delivery. This includes international transport, customs, dangerous goods, export-control execution, routing, forwarders and delivery performance.

It is a global leadership role with strong operational responsibility and close interfaces with Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Legal, Programme teams and international customers.

Responsibilities

The Director Global Logistics will establish and manage a global logistics system that is compliant, scalable and operationally effective.

The role will own customer delivery from release of the finished product through proof of delivery, including transport planning, Incoterms, shipment documentation, customs clearance and delivery visibility. It will also define and manage the global network of freight forwarders, carriers and customs brokers.

A major part of the role is ensuring that export-control, dangerous-goods and customs requirements are integrated early into the delivery process rather than addressed only when goods are ready to ship. The Director will therefore work closely with Legal, Supply Chain and Production to anticipate licence requirements, routing constraints and transport risks.

The role will establish common logistics standards, processes and KPIs across all production locations and deploy the logistics system into new factories and countries as Harmattan AI expands.

The Director will also build the team and external partner network required to improve delivery reliability, lead time and logistics cost.

Supply Chain owns material flow into and through Production. Global Logistics owns the controlled movement of released finished goods to the customer.

The role covers:

  • Customer delivery and international transport

  • Customs and trade operations

  • Export-control execution

  • Dangerous-goods logistics

  • Forwarder, carrier and broker management

  • Global routing and logistics network design

  • Shipment compliance and release

  • Logistics performance and cost management

Candidate Requirements

  • Experienced international logistics leader who is comfortable operating in a fast-growing and highly regulated industrial environment.

  • Significant experience in international logistics, preferably in defence or another highly regulated industrial environment, together with strong knowledge of customs, import/export processes, international freight, Incoterms and shipment documentation.

  • Experience with dangerous goods, regulated shipments and licence-dependent export processes is important, as is experience managing freight forwarders, carriers and customs brokers.

  • Strong operational judgement and ability to make clear decisions under delivery pressure while maintaining compliance. Experience building or scaling logistics processes across several countries or production locations would be a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable working across Production, Supply Chain, Quality, Legal and customer-facing teams and able to build processes that remain practical as the organisation grows.

  • Combines strong compliance discipline with a pragmatic operational mindset.

  • Anticipates problems before they affect customer delivery, creates clear ownership and is comfortable building structures where processes are still evolving.

  • Able to distinguish between what is legally required, what is operationally necessary and what can be simplified, while creating a global logistics organisation that can scale with the company.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations, sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals.
No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered.
We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026. Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné).


Your profile

We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy.

We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base, with well over 100 in the DACH region, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways.

We are seeking a German-fluent and Germany-based Enterprise Account Executive to help us win Enterprise (1,000+ employees) accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won.

In this role, you'll focus on new logo acquisition. Our emphasis is on your ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

You could be a great fit if:

  • You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

  • You have strong track record in Enterprise SaaS sales, having closed many $100k sales, and overachieved $1M+ quotas consistently. You have won competitive rip-and-replace opportunities of core/platform technologies.

  • You are proactive in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, and comfortable sourcing >50% of your own pipeline. You're both resourceful and innovative in finding new business opportunities.

  • You can confidently deliver micro-demos before engaging your SE partners. You can't imagine not being fluent in the product you sell.

  • You are highly skilled at discovery. You believe in preparation to establish a point of view, and through discovery validate or refine your perspective to identify a project's business drivers aligned to executive priorities.

  • You have strong business acumen. You quickly connect the dots between technical problems and their downstream business impacts. You craft compelling business cases with this context.

  • ⚔️ You're adept at competitive or evangelical selling in new or established markets.

  • ️ You skillfully guide prospects through the evaluation—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

  • You enjoy becoming an expert and tailoring discussions to address each prospect’s unique challenges.

  • ⚡️ Your peers describe you as action-oriented and persistent. You're always on the leaderboard for outbound effort and pipeline created.

  • Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You write and send crisp follow-up emails, on time. You also take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates. (We use HubSpot, Gong, Chili Piper and Apollo.)

  • ✈️ You are willing to travel at least 25% of the time for customer engagements and events.

Requirements:

  • You have 5+ years of full-cycle closing experience and have closed many >$100,000 ACV opportunities

  • You have experience selling complex platform technologies in a sales-led GTM motion

  • You are a new business hunter and are confident in your abilities to self-source >50% of your own pipeline

  • You have sold to multiple regions within EMEA and have strong written and verbal fluency in both English and German

Bonus Points:

Interview Process

jobs.description:
Security & Compliance Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany

About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

  • Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level.

  • Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure.

  • Exposure to a compliance automation platform.

  • Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure)

How we work

We are remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously.

The honest version

This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast.

Platform Support Engineering is a new team within Kraken’s Platform department. It will be the primary contact point for most day-to-day engineering interactions between the company’s 2,000 staff and the 120 engineers in the Platform department. The team will handle a high volume of tickets each month, supporting the business across a myriad of clients in the EU, North America, and Australia-Pacific regions on a 24/5 basis.

This role sits in the middle of that function, owning investigations end-to-end and beginning to shape the team's tooling and processes. You'll work with enough independence to own complex investigations, and close enough to the platform to keep developing your technical depth.

What you'll do

  • Act as the primary contact point for platform-related requests and non-critical incidents from engineers, Technical Account Managers, and Client Delivery Leads

  • Triage incoming tickets and alerts, gathering context and reproducing issues where possible

  • Monitor platform alerting channels and respond to non-critical alerts in line with defined processes

  • Resolve routine platform requests (access, configuration changes, environment queries, etc.)

  • Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant Platform Engineering teams for investigation and resolution, capturing their input and formalising it into runbooks for future use

  • Escalate to Senior Platform Support Engineers or the Platform Support Lead where pushback or seniority is required

  • Communicate clearly across a range of technical and non-technical audiences, translating between the two where needed

  • Identify recurring problems and flag opportunities to improve tooling, automation or documentation

  • Maintain and improve runbooks, FAQs and internal documentation

  • Work closely with Platform Engineers to build your understanding of how the platform is built and operated

  • Take ownership of ticket investigations end-to-end, including identifying when to escalate severity without prompting

  • Proactively flag risks and scope changes to stakeholders before they become problems

  • Identify and close gaps in team documentation without being asked

  • Begin contributing to tooling and automation improvements: scoped, well-defined pieces that reduce toil or improve the support workflow

What you'll need

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: AWS (console + CLI), Kubernetes (kubectl, real triage experience), Terraform (reading plans, running applies)

  • Comfortable triaging platform issues independently, knowing what to look for without being told and able to investigate before escalating

  • Experience communicating technical problems and resolutions to non-technical stakeholders

  • Can engage confidently in technical conversations with Platform Engineers when investigating complex issues, contributing context and understanding the response

  • Proactively flags risks and scope changes to stakeholders before they become problems

  • Able to identify gaps in documentation and close them, not just follow what exists

It would be great if you had

  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog or similar), using it to understand system behaviour, not just confirm alerts

  • Experience in a support, SRE, or platform ops role in a high-scale environment

  • Experience with GitOps workflows, understanding how infrastructure changes flow from code to production

  • Familiarity with incident management tooling (PagerDuty, incident.io, Rootly, or similar), not just receiving alerts but owning the response flow

  • Exposure to a client-facing or stakeholder-heavy environment (TAMs, CDLs, or similar non-engineering audiences)

  • Scripting ability in Python, Bash, or similar, enough to automate a repetitive task or parse logs efficiently

What success looks like in this role

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Platform Support sits at the intersection of engineering, clients, and product. Not every ticket has a clean answer. The people who do well here move through uncertainty rather than waiting for it to resolve.

    You communicate before you're asked to. Stakeholders (engineers, TAMs, CDLs) care most about knowing what's happening. Proactive, accurate updates matter more than perfect resolutions.

    You treat runbooks as a floor, not a ceiling. Following a runbook is the starting point. Finding the gap in it, fixing it, and making the next person's job easier is the standard we're aiming for.

    You escalate with context, not just symptoms. When something needs to go up the chain, it goes up with a clear problem statement, what's been tried, and what's needed. You don't just hand off the stress.

Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

VOS MISSIONS

  • Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Engineer (Backend Leaning) - Creative Agents

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team shaping its capabilities and architecture, with ownership from backend systems and agent infrastructure through to the customer-facing experience. You will help discover what works, turn experiments into reliable features, and use real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building production agents and expanding their capabilities through prompts, tool use, orchestration, new models and MCP integrations.

  • Designing and operating reliable backend systems for asynchronous creative generation and long-running tasks, with strong performance, observability, scalability and security.

  • Developing shared evaluations and live quality monitoring, including model-based assessment of image and video outputs.

  • Owning features end to end, from identifying user needs and prototyping to shipping across the stack and supporting them in production, alongside product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving and operating a live product.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong backend engineering skills, experience operating production systems, and sound fundamentals in APIs, cloud infrastructure, storage and asynchronous processing.

  • Hands-on experience developing agents, with an understanding of prompts, tools, execution logic, evaluations and the challenges of reliable, secure operation.

  • Evidence of independent, end-to-end ownership and confidence working across the stack, including frontend delivery when needed.

  • Good product judgement, clear communication and enthusiasm for creative agents.

We may also consider exceptional engineers with closely relevant experience. Familiarity with HTTP, WebSockets and asynchronous workers will help you build reliable communication between services and recover from failures.

Experience with multimodal generation, creative editors, MCP, or building products in a small, fast-moving team would be particularly valuable.

jobs.title: Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Events Marketing Manager

About Chili Piper

Chili Piper is a B2B SaaS company that helps GTM teams turn inbound leads into qualified meetings - instantly. Our Demand Conversion Platform makes it easier for buyers and sellers to connect fast, without the usual friction in the funnel.

We’re a fully remote, global team that loves building solutions that truly help our customers, moving fast, and having fun while creating something meaningful. We’re growing quickly and aiming big!

***CURRENTLY ONLY HIRING FOR THIS ROLE IN CANADA AND THE US***

About the role

At Chili Piper, community and events are at the heart of our GTM strategy. From intimate dinners to large-scale activations like our annual ChiliPalooza, we bring top GTM leaders together to connect, exchange ideas, and build lasting relationships. It's how we turn a room full of people into real pipeline, and how we've built a community that actually wants to hear from us.

We're hiring an Events Manager to scale these experiences and deepen our relationships with the GTM community: executive dinners, industry conferences, sponsorships, speaking moments, webinars, and ChiliPalooza. This is the person who turns our presence in a room, physical or virtual, into brand awareness, pipeline, and lasting relationships.

This role is part of our marketing team and works cross-functionally with Sales and Partnerships to run Chili Piper's global event strategy. You'll have real ownership of the calendar and where we show up, not just the execution. You'll shape the annual plan, then make it happen: logistics, promotion, on-site, and follow-up, all the way through to measurable impact.

This is a hands-on role. You're the one building the landing pages, pulling the CRM lists, and running the show on-site, not handing a brief to an agency and waiting. It's a strong fit for someone who is organized and proactive, thinks creatively about how we show up, and brings original ideas and a sense of humor to every event. It's fully remote, with travel to events as needed.

What you'll do

  • Own the annual event calendar. Decide, with marketing leadership, where Chili Piper should have a presence and why, and protect that focus as new opportunities come up

  • Bring original ideas, creativity, and humor to how we show up, so our events feel like Chili Piper and not like everyone else's

  • Manage execution end to end. Logistics, budgets, venues, vendors, shipments, swag, and on-site coordination, done by you and tracked by you

  • Run event promotion from start to finish. Build event and webinar landing pages, export and segment contact lists from Salesforce and HubSpot to target the right attendees by city or segment, and send invites, reminders, and follow-ups independently

  • Produce our virtual events and webinars end to end, from speaker prep and rehearsal to running the live show

  • Collaborate across teams. With Marketing on branding, design, and promotion; with Sales to identify and invite the right prospects and customers; with Partnerships to coordinate sponsors and activations

  • Ensure smooth on-site execution. Keep schedules on track and deliver a seamless experience from load-in to last handshake

  • Build and nurture community. Deepen our relationships with GTM leaders, partners, and community members so our events compound over time

  • Track performance. Collect attendee data, measure engagement, and report on outcomes and pipeline impact

  • Amplify results. Work with Marketing to repurpose event content, including photos, videos, and testimonials, for social and post-event communication

  • Manage vendors and budgets. Source partners, negotiate rates, and keep quality high and costs in check

  • Run the debrief on every event and turn what you learn into a stronger program next time

What we're looking for

  • Builder mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you how, you figure it out

  • Tech-savvy operator. You know your way around CRM exports, spreadsheets, event tools, and email automation

  • Hands-on doer. You do the execution and track the results yourself

  • Creative problem-solver. When a venue cancels or a vendor flakes, you find a workaround fast, and when the format is stale, you invent a better one

  • Organized and proactive. You turn chaos into systems and think two steps ahead

  • Strong communicator. You coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and execs smoothly

  • Customer-first. You care about memorable, frictionless experiences from invite to post-event follow-up

  • Curious and eager to learn. You're always exploring new tools, trends, and ideas, including AI, to make each event better than the last

Experience

  • 2+ years in event management, field marketing, or community roles, ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Proven ability to plan and execute events, from small dinners to large activations

  • Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Salesforce and HubSpot, and event platforms like Luma, Zoom Webinars or similar

  • Comfortable building simple landing pages, managing email lists, and running event promotion campaigns

  • Skilled in vendor sourcing, budget tracking, and on-site coordination

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and manage shifting priorities

  • Familiar with tracking and reporting event performance, including attendance, engagement, and pipeline impact

  • Experience managing partner collaborations or maintaining relationships with GTM leaders and communities is a plus

Nice to have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, RevOps, or MarTech

  • Prior involvement in partner activations or co-marketing events

  • Experience managing sponsorships or collaborations with other brands

  • Comfortable using analytics tools to measure event outcomes

  • A strong network within the GTM, Sales, or Marketing communities

  • Background in social or content amplification around events, for example capturing and repurposing event moments

Interview process

  1. Application review. We'll review your background and experience to make sure there's a good fit for the role.

  2. Culture add interview. A first chat to get to know you: what drives you, how you like to work, and what unique perspective you'd bring to Chili Piper.

  3. Assessment. A short, practical assignment to see how you think and approach a real events challenge. It's not a test, we just want to see your creativity and thought process.

  4. Executive interview. The final step. We'll talk about your bigger picture, your passion for the space, your understanding of our product, and why Chili Piper feels like the right next step for you.

TL;DR

We're not hiring a "planner." We're hiring someone who can own the full experience, from the CRM export to the on-site execution to the community that keeps growing after everyone goes home, and turn GTM moments into momentum and measurable results.

If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

Additional Information

Why you'll love being a part of our team:

Our team loves Chili Piper because we’re building the company of the future.

  • Work with an immensely talented global team

  • Work in a business that’s run fairly and transparently

  • Competitive pay based on market rate wherever you live

  • We lead by example--showing industry peers and leaders how to innovate, improve, and grow--while having fun

How we work:

  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a 100% distributed team working from around the world, and we've been fully remote since 2016. Our team members can work from wherever they want in the world, as long as they show up on our weekly all hands meeting on Zoom.

  • Solve interesting problems. The software landscape has exploded. There are dozens of solutions for each problem. We want to be different. We come up with new angles on existing problems or invent better solutions to help companies with their sales and marketing. Then we turn these ideas into beautiful, smart software.

  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.

  • Be helpful. Our first value as a company is help. Help our customers be successful. Help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our products. Help our team members reach their full potential.

The perks:

  • Unlimited vacation (and we do mean it, and we do take it!)

  • Generous health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Any equipment/software/tech that you need to do your job

  • Annual professional development stipend of $2,000 USD

  • Equity - all Pipers receive stock options

  • Annual company retreat in epic locations (past trips: Paris, Morocco, Tulum, Iceland, Ibiza, India). Check out the video from last year’s retreat in Tenerife.

Full-Time Canada, USA
