Senior Product Designer (Illustration & Motion, EdTech)

Location: 100% remote (EMEA, CET±2), with team gatherings in person a few times a year
Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week
Pay: €60.000 to €90.000 annually, adjusted by experience and location

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research, and now yours

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end: from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both.


You must have all of these to be considered:

  • A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

  • At least 2 years working as a product designer or a UI/UX designer inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

  • Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

  • Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

  • Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

  • Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

  • Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

  • Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

  • Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

  • You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

  • You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  1. Application and eligibility check — work authorization, timezone, availability

  2. Async assessment — 12 scenario-based, multiple-choice questions (~30 min) + when qualifying; 3 open questions (max. 45 min)

    1. If you pass the multiple choice section, you will asked to complete 3 open written questions (max. 45 min)

  3. Portfolio review — the design team will review your best work and thinking

  4. Behavioral interview — a conversation with our People team about how you work

  5. Take-home design task — ~120 minutes, scoped for this role, AI tools encouraged

  6. Hiring team interview — with a design team member and the Head of UX

  7. Skip-level conversation — with executive leadership

  8. Reference checks

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €60,000 - 90,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Senior Brand Marketing Manager (all genders)
Über die Stelle

Pflege ist eines der größten gesellschaftlichen Probleme unserer Zeit. marta ist die führende Plattform, die den intransparenten Markt für 24-Stunden-Betreuung radikal verändert. Wir machen Pflege einfacher zugänglich, transparent und bezahlbar.

Wir haben viel ausprobiert und viel gelernt. Performance-Marketing läuft. TV haben wir zwei Jahre lang mit echtem Druck gefahren. Mailing, Print und Partnerschaften kennen wir aus eigener Erfahrung, nicht aus Fallstudien. Jetzt geht es um die zweite Stufe: aus einzelnen Kanälen ein System machen, das trägt, und aus marta eine Marke, die Familien kennen, bevor sie zum ersten Mal suchen.

Darauf arbeiten wir gemeinsam hin: die erste große Marke für Altenpflege in Europa. Die gibt es bisher nicht.

Wir suchen die Person, die das plant, koordiniert und schreibt. Du denkst dir Kampagnen aus und bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material. Du entscheidest mit, welchen Kanal wir als Nächstes aufmachen und in welcher Reihenfolge. Und du sprichst mit denen, die das möglich machen: Sendern, Veranstaltern, Partnern, Produktionen.

Wenn du es leid bist, deine beste Idee in einer Präsentation sterben zu sehen, ist das hier der Unterschied: keine Pitch-Runden, keine Freigabekette, keine dritte Feedbackschleife. Du stellst deine Idee dem Performance-Marketing und den Gründern vor, und ihr entscheidet im selben Gespräch. Was montags beschlossen wird, läuft spätestens in der Woche darauf.

Wir sind eine der größten Plattformen im deutschen 24-Stunden-Pflegemarkt, finanziert von führenden Investoren wie Capnamic, Almaz Capital, RTL Ventures und Swiss Health Ventures, mit einem bundesweiten Franchise-System und Teams in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig.

Level: Senior. Du planst und koordinierst: Kanäle, Budget, Timing, Briefings. Die Texte schreibst du selbst.

An deiner Seite: unser Senior Performance Marketing Manager. Dort liegen Analyse, Attribution und die Aussteuerung der bezahlten Kanäle. Bei dir liegen Marke, Kampagnen und die Kanäle daneben. Ihr arbeitet auf Augenhöhe an einem Funnel.

Founder-Nähe: du arbeitest eng und direkt mit den Gründern an Marke, Botschaft und Ideen. Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen.

Perspektive: Head of Brand mit eigenem Team. Die Bedingung dafür sagen wir dir offen: mindestens ein zusätzlicher skalierbarer Push-Kanal, der uns spürbar schneller wachsen lässt.

Start: so bald wie möglich


Deine Rolle in unserem Team

Du bist die erste Person bei marta, die ausschließlich für die Marke da ist. 8 von 10 unserer treuesten Familien würden marta weiterempfehlen. Diese Geschichte erzählt bisher niemand systematisch. Du gibst marta eine Stimme, ein Gesicht und Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Was du jetzt festlegst, ist das Fundament für alles, was danach kommt.

Was du machst

  • Kampagnen, die hängen bleiben. Du entwickelst Kampagnen für Familien, die vor einer der schwersten Entscheidungen ihres Lebens stehen. Keine Werbeanzeigen, sondern etwas, das man sich merkt. Und du bringst sie bis zum fertigen Material.
  • Kanäle planen und koordinieren. Du entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes testen, in welcher Reihenfolge und mit welchem Erfolgskriterium. Und du sagst genauso klar, was wir uns sparen, weil du Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Kanälen mitbringst.
  • Texte, die du selbst schreibst. Landingpages, SEO- und Ratgeber-Content, Anzeigentexte, E-Mails, Videoskripte, Social, Print. Am Anfang entstehen sie an deinem Schreibtisch, zunehmend KI-gestützt. Wenn ein Kanal skaliert und wir echtes Volumen brauchen, holen wir Unterstützung dazu. 
  • Produktion briefen. Für Film, Design und größere Produktionen arbeitest du mit Freelancern und Spezialisten. Du briefst sie, beurteilst, was zurückkommt, und hältst die Marke über alle Kanäle konsistent.
  • Social Media, UGC und Community. Hinter marta steht eine große Community aus Betreuungskräften. Daraus machst du Formate, Geschichten und nutzergenerierte Inhalte. Unser Ziel: der größte Pflegekanal Deutschlands. 
  • PR und Presse. Du arbeitest mit einer PR-Agentur, schreibst Pressemitteilungen und baust Regionalpresse als Kanal auf.
  • CRM und Lifecycle. Die Entscheidung für eine 24-Stunden-Betreuung zieht sich über Wochen. Willkommensstrecken, Reaktivierung, WhatsApp: die richtige Botschaft zum richtigen Zeitpunkt statt nur Bottom of Funnel. Die Strecken füllst du mit dem richtigen Content und hast ein Auge dafür was funktioniert und was nicht.
  • Botschaft und Tonalität. Du übersetzt unsere fünf Personas in konkrete Botschaften und Touchpoints. Familien entscheiden emotional und nach Qualität, nicht nach Preis. Dein Text muss das treffen.

Dazu kommen die Themen, die du als Erstes in die Hand nimmst: Bewertungen und Google Business Profile, eine Mechanik für Empfehlungen, Regionalpresse und die Sichtbarkeit von marta in der KI-Suche.


So sieht Erfolg aus
Nach 90 Tagen: die erste CRM-Strecke ist live, zwei Kanäle sind erfolgreich angetestet, die ersten Ergebnisse sind vielversprechend, und wir gehen in die Skalierung.
Nach 6 Monaten: die Markenbotschaft steht und ist an allen Kontaktpunkten sichtbar, zwei bis drei eigene Kampagnen sind live, und das Performance-Marketing arbeitet mit frischem Material statt mit denselben drei Anzeigen.
Nach 12 Monaten: marta hat eine Kampagne, die Familien wiedererkennen, der YouTube-Kanal wächst und liefert Material, das in anderen Kanälen weiterläuft, Branded und Direct Traffic steigen, und neue Quellen liefern verlässlich mehr als 3.000 zusätzliche Leads pro Monat..


Das bringst du zu uns mit

Auf diese fünf Punkte schauen wir. Alles danach ist ein Plus und kein Filter.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre in Marke, Kampagnen oder Content. Agentur oder inhouse, beides passt. Die Jahre sind nicht das Kriterium, die Arbeiten sind es.
  • Arbeiten, die du selbst gemacht hast, nicht nur verantwortet: Texte, Kampagnen, Videos, Seiten. Zwei bis drei davon würden wir gern sehen.
  • Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch (muttersprachliches Niveau, C2) und kannst eine Idee so aufschreiben, dass andere sie umsetzen können.
  • Du hast mindestens einen Kanal außerhalb von Paid Search aufgebaut oder getestet: Mailing, Print, Partnerschaften, Events, Podcast oder TV. Du legst Erfolgskriterien vorher fest und brichst auch mal ab.
  • Du hast mit externen Dienstleistern gearbeitet: auswählen, briefen, Budget führen, Qualität beurteilen.

Das hilft zusätzlich
  • Du hast selbst einmal einen Social-Media-Account aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht, beruflich oder privat.
  • Du hast eine Marke mitgestaltet und weißt, wie aus Farben, Designelementen und Sprache ein stimmiges Bild wird.
  • Erfahrung in CRM und Lifecycle (HubSpot, Klaviyo, Superchat oder Vergleichbares).
  • Video und Social sind dir nicht fremd. Du erkennst ein Format, das trägt, und bekommst es auch mit kleinen Mitteln umgesetzt.
  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Content-Produktion und ein klares Urteil, wo sie trägt und wo nicht.
  • Erfahrung mit erklärungsbedürftigen, emotionalen Entscheidungen. Lead-Gen statt reinem E-Commerce.
  • Erfahrung im Verhandeln von Media-, Sponsoring- oder Produktionsbudgets.
  • Englisch C1 für die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Wenn du bei ein oder zwei Punkten unsicher bist: bewirb dich und schreib uns, wie du dir das aneignen würdest. Wir entscheiden nach deinen Erfahrungen und unserem Gespräch, nicht nach einer Checkliste.
Diese Rolle passt nicht, wenn
  • du mit einem Rebranding anfangen willst. Logo und Farben sind nicht unser Engpass. Der Engpass sind Kampagnen und Kanäle.
  • du konzipieren, aber nicht schreiben willst. Am Anfang entstehen die Texte an deinem Schreibtisch.
  • du am liebsten in einer Disziplin bleibst. Dein Feld reicht von der Mailing-Strecke bis zum Gespräch mit einem Sender.
  • du Kreation nach Geschmack beurteilst statt nach Wirkung.
  • du lange Abstimmungsschleifen brauchst. Die Wege sind kurz, dafür entsteht viel in kurzer Zeit.


Warum marta?

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile (VSOP nach Jahr 1) und Performance-Bonus
  • 27 Urlaubstage
  • 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche und Vertrauensarbeitszeit
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Zugang zu Fitness, Studios und Wellbeing
  • Ein internationales Team mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Berlin, Bonn, Sibiu und Danzig
  • Unser Prozess
  • Fachgespräch, kurze Kampagnenaufgabe, Kennenlernen mit den Gründern, Reference Calls. Wer im Prozess sitzt, sagen wir dir vorher. Entscheidung in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

Deine Bewerbung
Schick uns zwei bis drei Projekte, auf die du stolz bist, und in zwei Sätzen, warum. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schick alles an Wir stehen für Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder Lebensweg. Wir bauen bewusst ein Team, das die Familien widerspiegelt, für die wir da sind.

jobs.description:
Senior Network Engineer (all genders)
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Network Engineer to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


Contabo Group operates one of Europe's largest cloud infrastructure platforms, with data centres across Europe and beyond. As our new Senior Network Engineer, you take on the network backbone that thousands of customers rely on every day, with real ownership from day one.

Right now, the biggest milestone on your plate is the build out of our new AI data centre. You inherit a fully designed Leaf-Spine architecture built on Arista EOS, BGP EVPN, and VXLAN, take ownership of it, refine it where it needs refining, and drive everything from commissioning through to stable production operations. Alongside that, you keep our existing LTG infrastructure running reliably: you design, build, and operate complex network, server, and security systems, analyse and resolve faults, and harden our network security through scrubbers, firewalls, ACLs, and NAC.

You monitor network traffic and infrastructure performance, extrapolate the KPIs that matter to management, and coordinate with external service providers and remote hands across the globe. You keep our network diagrams, runbooks, change logs, and system documentation in good shape, and you work closely with Platform Engineering on Cilium BGP peering, Kubernetes node network configuration, and IPAM, acting as the ongoing interface between NetOps and Platform.

You join a self-organising, agile team that owns its problems end to end, from analysis to resolution, without micromanagement. On top of that, you will have real room to grow into infrastructure automation, DDoS mitigation with Nokia Deepfield, observability, and BGP EVPN fabric engineering, alongside plenty of national and international project work.

You report directly to our Head of Network and become the permanent owner of everything networking related at Contabo Group, Blue and Black alike. Communication, team orientation, problem solving, and analytical thinking matter just as much here as deep technical expertise, since you will regularly work across teams and explain complex topics to people outside networking.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with complex, scalable networks and fabric infrastructures on Cisco and/or Arista, ideally with real Leaf-Spine and BGP EVPN VXLAN exposure
  • strong expertise in WAN connectivity, data centre peering, uplink management, VPN, and IPv6
  • strong expertise in security administration and DDoS mitigation (e.g. Nokia Deepfield, Aurologic), plus solid monitoring skills with tools like Grafana, Check_MK, or Zabbix
  • good scripting and automation skills with Ansible, Terraform, Python, or similar
  • strong analytical and strategic thinking, paired with clear, confident communication
  • a results-driven, hands-on mindset with a high standard of performance, customer orientation, and composure under pressure
  • genuine team spirit, reliability, and a self-driven way of working that thrives without micromanagement
  • experience with Network Access Control solutions, BGP Flowspec, virtualisation (Proxmox), and IPAM systems such as NetBox
  • strong conflict-handling skills, a knack for building contacts across teams, and openness to change
  • a basic understanding of Kubernetes networking, ideally paired with an Arista certification (or equivalent Cisco knowledge), a completed IT apprenticeship or equivalent, and German language skills alongside excellent English
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office

  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities

  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

jobs.description:
Director, Account Management - UK

As the Director of Account Management for the UK and Europe, you will drive the growth and retention of Marqeta’s top regional customers through developing a high-performing group of Account Managers. Your core focus involves navigating complex enterprise organisations, aligning with their long-term strategic goals, and unlocking mutual revenue through renewals and portfolio expansion.

Acting as the primary commercial owner for this region, you will partner seamlessly with Solutions & Delivery, Product, Engineering, Legal and compliance to ensure Marqeta remains deeply embedded in our clients' operations as they scale globally.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

  • Team Leadership: Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Account Managers. You will guide their account strategies, support them through complex commercial negotiations, and foster a culture of continuous growth.

  • Drive Regional Revenue Growth: Own the commercial strategy for an assigned portfolio of existing strategic accounts in the UK and EU. Spot and drive opportunities for growth, such as expanding into new European corridors, launching new card programmes, or adopting additional Marqeta products like Credit or RiskControl.

  • Lead Renewals and Pricing: Manage complex contract renewals and pricing negotiations. You will support your team to structure commercial terms that ensure long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships while reflecting the nuances of the European payments landscape.

  • Build Executive Relationships: Cultivate genuine, trusted relationships with C-level executives and key product stakeholders across our key accounts. You should be viewed as a strategic advisor who understands their business, not just a supplier.

  • Operational Excellence: Challenge the status quo and refine our operational account management processes to ensure we are set up for success.

  • Strategic Account Planning: Guide your team to develop clear, actionable Account Plans and run impactful Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to align Marqeta’s roadmap with your customers’ strategic goals.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the internal voice of your European customers and your team. Champion region-specific feature requests, unblock escalations, and coordinate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, and Operations to deliver excellent service.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay plugged into the UK and European fintech, payments, and embedded finance landscape—including regulatory shifts like PSD3 or UK FCA guidelines—so you can proactively advise clients on market trends.

Who You Are

This role requires a solid foundation in payments and any specific experience with card issuing is a huge bonus that will set you up for quick success and allow you to drive immediate impact.

  • Proven Account Leader: 10+ years of experience in enterprise account management, strategic partnerships, or existing-client sales within complex enterprise SaaS or financial technology.

  • People Manager: Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and developing a team of account managers or commercial professionals to hit retention and growth targets.

  • Commercial Acumen: Extensive experience managing complex, multi-year, multi-million pound/euro contract renewals and commercial negotiations.

  • Relationship Builder: Proven ability to map and navigate large organisations, building rapport with both technical leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering) and commercial leaders (CEOs, GMs, VPs of Product).

  • Strategic Thinker: A knack for understanding a customer's business model inside and out, connecting their specific pain points to Marqeta’s solutions.

  • Cross-functional Collaborator: A track record of leading by influence across global internal teams (Product, Legal, Delivery) to deliver for the client, often working across multiple time zones.

  • Adaptable: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment where priorities can shift and agility is essential.

Recruiter for this role

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 2 x 45 min calls

  • Presentation Round to team

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Wellbeing programs i.e. Modern Health, HealthKick and much more…

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

Marqeta cares about your privacy. Personal data that is provided as part of the application and recruitment process is processed in accordance with the Applicant Privacy Notice. Additional information for California residents can be found here.

jobs.title: Data Science Lead
jobs.description:
Data Science Lead

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organizations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., UAE, Singapore and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

 

Do you want to lead a data science team on a problem the industry has not solved yet, while still writing code yourself? Are you excited about building the data foundation for how compliance works when the customer is an autonomous agent rather than a person? Are you looking for a values led company where a small team is trusted with a question that matters commercially in months, not years?

 

The impact you will have:

You will lead data science inside Elliptic's Intelligence team, alongside Intelligence Collection, Research and Investigations, and Professional Services. This is deliberately a player-coach role with a prospect of scaling a team. At first you will lead a small team of data scientists and you are expected to own the team's direction, performance and growth. You will own the evidence for the models your team builds, and you will represent them at Elliptic's model risk governance forum. This is not a compliance tax bolted onto the technical work: it is the reason institutions trust our outputs.

The reason we are hiring a lead as we add more data scientists is that a small team working on an unsolved problem needs someone who intrinsically understands the domain, not a layer of management above it. You will set what this team works on, hire the next people into it, and be the person whose technical judgement the team trusts because you can do the work yourself.

 

What you will do:

  • Lead and grow the team. Set objectives with your data scientists in the context of company strategy, own their performance and development, and be the manager who has the difficult conversation rather than deferring it. Level the team against Elliptic's Intelligence career framework and build real development paths.

  • Hire the next data scientists. Own the hiring process end to end with support: levels, job descriptions, hiring plan, interview panel and bar, and the hiring decision. Team growth to seven to nine people over time depends on you getting this right early.

  • Build the collection for the future of compliance. Take it from a directive to a specification to delivered data: define what good looks like, sequence the work, set the quality bar, and be honest about what the dataset does and does not support.

  • Own model governance for your team's models. Keep the model inventory current and correctly tiered, make sure validation and testing evidence exists at the standard each tier requires, monitor for drift and act on threshold breaches, and submit material changes and production deployments for review with the testing artefacts attached. Own the remediation of issues raised against your models, to agreed deadlines.

  • Lead Elliptic's data science work. Frame the research question, run the first experiments, and form a defensible view of what Elliptic needs to be able to do and by when. Bring that view to Intelligence leadership, the Chief Scientist and Product as a recommendation rather than as an open question.

  • Stay technically hands on. Write code, review your team's work at the level of method rather than output, and make the method calls yourself when they matter.

  • Own the team's existing commitments. The team's current work on clustering, attribution, heuristics and labelling continues to serve the platform. You own its reliability and its trade offs, and you decide what to stop.

  • Work across functions. Partner with Intelligence Collection, Collection Engineering, Research and Investigations, the Chief Scientist, Product and Engineering, so that data science work lands as platform capability rather than as analysis nobody uses.

  • Set the AI working standard for the team. Decide how your team uses AI in its engineering and research workflow, what must be verified and how, and hold the team to it.

 

What you will achieve in the first 6 months:

  • The collection plan delivered at a scale that supports real model or heuristic work, with a documented path to maintaining it.

  • An agreed Elliptic position on the evolution of compliance systems, timed against expected industry demand, with the first capability work either underway or deliberately deferred with stated reasons.

  • At least one data science hire made, and the existing levelled against the career framework with development plans in place.

  • Model governance in good standing for everything your team owns: inventory current and correctly tiered, no overdue validations on the highest tiers, monitoring in place with acted-upon thresholds, and no open issues past their remediation deadline.

  • Data science objectives for Intelligence agreed and delivering, with other functions able to state what they can expect from the team and when.

  • A visible improvement in the reliability or throughput of the team's core output, attributable to a change you made.

  • Technical credibility intact: the team takes your method judgements seriously because you can do the work.

 

You will be a great fit here if you:

  • Want to lead a team without leaving the technical work behind, and can say honestly where you draw that line.

  • Are comfortable being accountable for a question nobody has answered yet, including for saying what you do not know.

  • Treat management as the work rather than as overhead: objectives, feedback, development and difficult conversations included.

  • Treat governance as part of building good models rather than as paperwork that follows them, and would rather surface a problem with your own model than have someone else find it.

  • Are pragmatic about trade offs between rigour and speed, and can explain the trade off you chose.

  • Make other teams more effective rather than treating them as consumers of your team's output.

  • Are curious about how the company operates beyond your own function.

  • Care about the mission of using intelligence to fight financial crime and protect the global financial system.

 

Our ideal candidate has:

  • AI fluency, which is essential for this role. You must be able to demonstrate how you apply AI tools and approaches within a data science workflow: writing and debugging code, exploring unfamiliar data, accelerating pipeline and model work, and automating repetitive tasks. You must also be able to show how you critically evaluate the output, where you would not rely on it, and how you set verification expectations for a team rather than only for yourself. This is assessed in a dedicated stage of the interview process, working with your own tooling.

  • Demonstrated experience managing data scientists or machine learning engineers: setting objectives, owning performance including underperformance, and developing people. You can point to someone whose career changed because of how you managed them.

  • Experience hiring into a technical team, including defining the bar rather than only sitting on panels.

  • Deep, hands on data science and machine learning capability that is current. Strong Python and SQL, and the ability to interrogate large behavioural or transactional datasets yourself and defend your method under challenge.

  • A track record of taking an ambiguous question to a delivered dataset, model or capability, including deciding what was good enough.

  • Experience with a modern data stack comparable to ours: a cloud data lake, Spark or Databricks, and AWS.

  • Clear communication with technical and non technical stakeholders, and the ability to cascade direction to a team so that each person knows why their work matters.

  • Based in Washington, D.C. or willing to relocate there.

  • US citizenship

 

Bonus Points for:

  • Work on agentic systems, LLM agents or autonomous transaction flows, whether in compliance, payments, fraud or infrastructure.

  • Experience building a large dataset or collection from nothing, including the unglamorous parts: schema decisions, quality checks, and maintenance.

  • Blockchain or on chain data experience: clustering, attribution, heuristics, anomaly detection, mempool analysis, or research into privacy preserving systems.

  • Experience in payments, fraud or risk data science, where the cost of a false negative is commercial rather than academic.

  • Having grown a team from a few people to a full department, and being able to describe what broke on the way.

  • A PhD or equivalent research training, or a record of published applied research.

  • Experience in a regulated environment or with model risk management frameworks, whether in financial services, or as a vendor to it, or in another domain with equivalent assurance requirements.

Job Benefits

> How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

 

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

Consultant Neurologist PAYE

Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

jobs.title: Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery
jobs.description:
Global Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Dust is hiring a Head of AI Deployment & Partner Delivery to make high-impact Dust deployments repeatable at scale.

When customers deploy Dust well, AI agents become part of how their teams work every day. Your job is to make that happen consistently, whether a deployment is led by Dust or by a trusted partner. You will lead our most complex customer deployments, turn what works, technically and organizationally, into clear playbooks, and build the partner delivery capacity that lets more customers succeed with Dust in 2027 and beyond.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will lead and grow Dust’s global AI Deployment team, stay directly involved in our most important deployments, and build the methods, standards, and partner network that allow delivery to scale without depending on you for every engagement.

You will work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to connect what customers want to achieve with how deployments are planned, delivered, and measured.

This is a chance to define how an AI-native company delivers transformation: what an exceptional deployment looks like, how value is measured, and how partners become delivery teams our customers trust.

What you’ll do

Lead and grow the global AI Deployment team

  • Lead Dust’s existing global AI Deployment team and set its direction, priorities, and standards.

  • Hire and develop deployment leaders and practitioners as customer demand grows.

  • Shape roles, career paths, and coverage across regions, customer segments, and deployment types.

  • Coach the team through complex customer situations and hold a consistently high bar for the work.

  • Set up the operating rhythms, capacity planning, and reporting the function needs to scale.

Define how Dust deployments are delivered

  • Build one deployment method, from discovery through handoff, that Dust and partner teams can both follow to the same standard.

  • Define which deployments Dust should lead, which a partner can deliver well, and how work moves between the two.

  • Set clear entry and exit criteria and go-live readiness checks, and track delivery health: time to first value, go-live quality, and customer satisfaction.

  • Run regular delivery reviews, spot at-risk engagements early, and bring the right Dust and partner people together quickly when a deployment is blocked.

  • Turn lessons from each engagement into reusable playbooks, templates, and reference architectures, and recurring friction into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Lead AI transformation with strategic customers

  • Personally lead complex, high-priority, and first-of-their-kind deployments, from scoping to lasting adoption, bringing in Solutions Engineering, Product, and Engineering when complexity or risk calls for it.

  • Help customer leaders define what AI transformation means for their organization: map how teams work today and identify the workflows where agents can create the most value.

  • Align executives, IT, security, and business teams on goals, use cases, and success measures, with a baseline before launch and measured impact after.

  • Design change programs for each deployment: executive sponsorship, communication plans, role-based enablement, and clear adoption milestones.

  • Develop AI operators and champions inside customer teams, and help customers update ways of working, governance, and ownership so agents become part of how teams operate.

  • Track adoption after launch, act quickly when teams aren’t changing how they work, and hand off to Customer Success with a clear picture of what comes next.

Build a high-quality partner delivery network

  • Work with Partnerships to assess partners’ delivery capability, technical depth, and customer readiness.

  • Start with a small, carefully selected group of partner practitioners and grow capacity as quality is proven.

  • Co-create onboarding, training, certification, and train-the-trainer programs so partners can develop their own Dust experts.

  • Co-deliver early partner engagements, then help partners progress toward delivering independently, leading adoption, not just implementation.

  • Ensure customers experience Dust and its partners as one aligned team, with clear responsibilities on every engagement.

Requirements

  • You have at least 6 years of experience leading and developing customer-facing deployment or delivery teams, ideally across multiple regions or customer segments and through periods of fast change.

  • You have led complex enterprise deployments or transformation programs and delivered measurable customer outcomes.

  • You have built or significantly improved a deployment methodology, professional services model, or delivery function, adding the structure needed to scale without unnecessary process.

  • You have led organizational change alongside technology rollouts, and built champion networks or adoption plans that changed how teams work after the project ended.

    You don’t need to be a machine-learning engineer. Beyond that, we care more about evidence that you have built high-performing delivery systems than about a perfect sequence of titles.

  • You understand how systems integrators, consultancies, and implementation partners staff, deliver, and grow a practice, and you have built enablement or certification programs that created lasting capability in teams you didn’t manage.

  • You have turned around engagements at risk from scope, staffing, technical complexity, or stakeholder misalignment, and you know when to standardize, when to adapt, and when to reset.

  • You are credible with customer executives, partner leaders, and technical practitioners, and you communicate clearly with all of them.

  • You are a hands-on, low-ego leader with a builder’s instinct: you would rather solve the problem than hand off a recommendation.

  • You are comfortable traveling to customers and partners when it matters most.

AI and technical credibility

  • Advise customers on where AI agents can create meaningful value and where they can’t yet, and explain why to technical teams, business leaders, and executives.

  • Understand how agents work in practice: prompting, context, tool use, retrieval, evaluations, reliability, and cost.

  • Challenge a deployment plan’s assumptions about integrations, data connectors, authentication, permissions, security, and production readiness, and discuss the trade-offs with engineers.

  • Design evaluation approaches that connect AI performance to customer and business outcomes.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Compensation: $300K – $350K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

jobs.description:
Product Manager (Atomic Team)

About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

  • A utility business with a strong free tier

  • Experience with high-volume consumer tools

  • Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate.

Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact!

Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.

Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values.

Our Benefits

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home, our offices are pet-friendly

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

🍻 BBQs, game nights, meetups in the Swiss Alps, or in kayaks on Lake Zurich—we’re serious about great coffee, karaoke, and Mario Kart, too!

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

jobs.description:
Full-stack Engineer - Creative Agents

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a full-stack engineer to help build the next generation of Creative Agents at ElevenLabs.

Our ambition is to make agents a primary way people create across ElevenCreative. We are building systems that turn ideas into high-quality audio, image and video, bringing models and creative tools together without requiring users to become prompting experts.

The creative agent is already live. You will join a small team where engineers own complete problems across the full stack: frontend, backend, agent architecture and infrastructure. You should be equally comfortable building a user-facing feature, designing the services behind it, and deploying and operating the system in production. You will combine strong engineering with product judgement, taking ideas from early prototypes through to reliable features and using real customer feedback to guide what we build next.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building complete agent-powered features, from frontend interfaces and application state to backend services, APIs and data storage.

  • Developing agent capabilities and integrations, including model orchestration, creative tools and reliable asynchronous workflows for audio, image and video generation.

  • Building and operating the infrastructure behind these features, improving quality, performance, scalability and security through evaluations, monitoring and testing.

  • Owning a problem area from discovery and prototyping to deployment and ongoing operation, working closely with product, design and engineering.

You will help shape both what the agent can do and how people use it across ElevenCreative. The work combines substantial greenfield development with improving a live product, with room to experiment and directly influence the product's direction.

Requirements

We care about evidence of exceptional engineering: products you have shipped, difficult problems you have solved, and systems you have owned.

We are looking for:

  • Strong engineering skills across both frontend and backend, with a track record of independently building complete production applications.

  • Confidence designing user interfaces, backend services, APIs and data models, and understanding how these components work together as a system.

  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, deployment, asynchronous processing, testing and observability, with the ability to debug and resolve problems across the full stack.

  • Evidence of end-to-end ownership, strong product judgement and clear communication, taking ambiguous problems from technical design through to shipping and ongoing operation.

You should be excited about creative agents and comfortable learning quickly as models, tools and user needs evolve.

Hands-on experience building production agents, evaluations, MCP integrations, creative editors or multimodal products would be particularly valuable, as would experience building in a small, fast-moving team.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
Account Operations & Farming Specialist

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Operations & Farming Specialist based in Switzerland.

This role sits at the intersection of IT Operations, account infrastructure, and media buying support in a fast-growing international environment. You’ll take ownership of account access, lifecycle management, subscriptions, and operational processes while supporting Media Buying teams. A key part of the position is building and developing Meta account farming infrastructure and ensuring accounts are prepared for effective use. You’ll work with suppliers, proxies, browser profiles, email, phone numbers, 2FA, verification, and recovery processes. The role also involves identifying account-quality issues, analyzing losses and blocks, and improving processes through automation. It’s a strong opportunity for a systematic and proactive specialist who enjoys solving operational challenges and building scalable infrastructure.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage employee access, including account provisioning, access maintenance, onboarding, and offboarding processes.
  • Manage user accounts, services, internal tools, subscriptions, licenses, and related operational resources.
  • Provide IT Operations support to Media Buying teams, ensuring they have the accounts, tools, and infrastructure required to work effectively.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, account inventories, and current operational statuses.
  • Build, manage, and continuously improve Meta account farming and account infrastructure processes.
  • Prepare advertising accounts and related resources for Media Buying teams.
  • Manage suppliers and account resources, including proxies, email addresses, phone numbers, 2FA, browser profiles, and recovery data.
  • Handle account checkpoints, verification, recovery, and related troubleshooting processes.
  • Monitor account quality and analyze the causes of account losses, restrictions, or blocks.
  • Collaborate with Farm teams to share knowledge, adopt relevant expertise, and improve operational practices.
  • Identify repetitive or inefficient processes and define requirements for automation.
  • Contribute to a structured, scalable, and well-documented account operations environment.

    • Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with Meta farming and/or advertising account infrastructure.

  • Practical experience handling checkpoints, verification, and account recovery.

  • Experience managing suppliers or other account-related resources.

Growth Marketing Project Manager / Consultant (German required)

Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office)

  • We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at what.digital.

  • The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow.

And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you.


What you'll do:

  • Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns.

  • Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team.

  • Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback.

  • Run data and AI-assisted analyses to find growth opportunities and turn them into business cases and new projects.

  • Keep an eye on budgets and billing, with support from our finance team.

  • Optional: lead the specialist team, including team happiness and recruiting.

Key & Essential Skills:

  • Ideally 7+ years in a performance agency (not media buying), including 3+ years leading a team of 3+.

  • Deep knowledge of at least 3 marketing channels (e.g. SEO, Google Ads, Meta, content), with CHF 1M+ in total managed budget.

  • Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in.

  • Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English.

  • Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting.

What makes you a fit:

  • You like taking ownership and seeing things through.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks:

  • Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich.

  • You'll have real responsibility and influence - and a team that has your back. If you see something that could be improved, speak up - we're listening.

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event.

  • Apply via our website with your CV and a 2-3 min intro video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what attracted you to this role and share an example where you helped a client grow or improved something at work.

Aufbau integriertes Kreativ-Team 
Wir befinden uns in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung und bauen unsere kreativen Kompetenzen gezielt aus. Im Zuge dessen entwickeln wir ein schlagkräftiges Design-Team an der Schnittstelle von Geschäftsstrategie, Marke und Design. Das Team arbeitet künftig für alle Unternehmen der Gruppe, mehr dazu findest du auch auf https://Hotz.studio. 
 
Unser Anspruch ist es dabei, strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken mit exzellenter kreativer und gestalterischer Arbeit zu verbinden. Wir verstehen Strategie und Design nicht als getrennte Disziplinen, sondern als gegenseitige Enabler, die für Unternehmen und Marken nachhaltig Wert schaffen. Für unser Kreativ-Team suchen wir nach Kandidaten, die diesen Weg aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
 
Gemeinsames Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit
Gesucht werden Persönlichkeiten, die sich gerne in ein dynamisches Umfeld einbringen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit anderen Talenten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Erwartungen an eine klassische Agentur übertreffen. Wichtig sind uns eine agile, unkomplizierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägter Teamgedanke. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – unabhängig von Funktion oder Hierarchie. Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.

On-site, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice möglich

  • Ausarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von visuellen Identitäten, Corporate Designs und Designsystemen
  • Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Logos, Logo-Systemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten
  • Entwicklung digitaler Markenanwendungen, insbesondere Websites, Responsive Designs und digitale Designsysteme

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Art Directors, Strateg:innen und Berater:innen bei der Entwicklung starker und umsetzbarer Lösungen
  • Einbringen eigener Ideen und aktives Mitdenken bei kreativen und gestalterischen Fragestellungen
  • Aufbereitung und Präsentation von Entwürfen und Varianten im Team sowie gegebenenfalls gegenüber Kund:innen
  • Aktive Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung deiner Kenntnisse in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite und neuen Design-Tools
  • Bereitschaft, dich in strategische und unternehmerische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten und zur Weiterentwicklung des Kreativ-Teams beizutragen


Dein Profil

  • Sehr starkes, designorientiertes Portfolio mit überzeugenden Branding-, Website- und Digitalprojekten
  • Zwingende Erfahrung im Bereich Branding, Corporate Design und Visual Identities
  • Erfahrung mit Logoentwicklung, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie, Farbsystemen und Bildwelten
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie eine Marke vom Logo und Grundsystem bis zur digitalen Anwendung funktioniert
  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit Figma und sicherer Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Suite

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant

This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

  • Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you:

  • 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

  • Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

  • Clear, polished written English

  • You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

  • Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

  • Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

  • At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

  • German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

  • Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

  • Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

jobs.description:
Hackers wanted – Software Engineers

ABOUT OUR COMPANY 

We are an engineering organization. Our mission is to “Ship great software” and build custom, large-scale software platforms on time, on budget, on target and on quality. 

In over two decades, we have never failed to deliver what we promised. 

85% of our members are software engineers with a background in computer science, physics or mathematics, many also with a strong background in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence.

freiheit.com technologies was founded in Hamburg in the midst of the first internet boom in the last millennium in 1999.

Since then, we’ve been building custom software platforms and helping our clients to create their future business models based on software.

For over a quarter of a century, we have been working for the "Who's Who" of German and European industry and business.
Retail, automotive, e-commerce, healthcare and more.

Our large-scale software platforms are used by millions of users every day. Each product has a business-critical, strategic relevance for our clients.

Together we make “mission impossible” possible.

We are a team of 300+ members with people from all over the world. In our engineering hubs in Hamburg and Lisbon we come together to create things that no one has built before.

Our teams work data-driven to constantly optimize their own productivity by removing friction from their work. Each member takes on end-to-end responsibility for their work. To be successful, you need to be productive. To be productive, you need to be efficient and effective.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.



ABOUT THE JOB

  • Your responsibility: From day one, you’ll own your stories and take end-to-end responsibility for your tasks. 

  • Your team: You'll work in a small team of no more than five full-stack engineers. Like this, our teams are more efficient and can move fast.

  • Your work: You’ll be involved in the entire software engineering lifecycle of your project - from product requirements and design to testing, deployment and operations. You’ll see how people actually use what you build and continuously improve it based on user feedback and real usage data.

  • Your projects: We partner with clients across all industries who trust us with their most challenging software problems. We take full ownership from the first idea to the final roll-out. You’re not joining a client team as an extra pair of hands - you’re part of the team responsible for solving the problem. We don’t do body leasing.

  • Your impact: You will contribute to some of the largest, business-critical and most demanding software projects in Europe.

  • Your perspective: No matter your experience, everyone starts as a newbie and passes through all of our engineering levels. From owning small to medium feature sets to being responsible for the whole codebase. Here you can learn how to build and run large-scale software systems – and grow into a full-stack software engineer. 

  • Your community: You’ll work with smart, like-minded people who care about what they do and the people around them. With over 300 people across our Hamburg and Lisbon hubs, we work hard, support each other, and make sure to create a work environment where you can become the best version of yourself. 

    • We are a company for engineers by engineers. Most of your time is spent solving problems with like-minded people, writing software and working together with your team in our beautiful offices in the heart of Hamburg & Lisbon.  

    We expect a lot. It's not easy. But we guarantee you it will be fun.

As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.

You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person.
