jobs.title: Director, Partnerships
jobs.description:
Director, Partnerships

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As Director of Partnerships, you will lead the strategy and growth of Toptal’s global partner ecosystem, turning strategic relationships into measurable revenue, differentiated services, and expanded market opportunity across Toptal’s existing and emerging services, products, and new businesses. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, AI Services, you will work closely with Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, and senior leadership to identify, activate, and grow strategic partners. This includes joint go-to-market motions, partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, co-selling, joint solutions, marketplace and reseller opportunities, talent certifications, partnership tiers, executive relationships, and partner-funded programs such as Marketing Development Funds (MDF) and sponsorships.

The successful candidate will combine commercial instincts, partnership strategy, operational discipline, and executive relationship management. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can develop the strategy, put pen to paper, build the plans and materials, work directly on opportunities, and drive execution through measurable business results.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and hands-on partnerships leader with strong commercial instincts, executive communication skills, and experience across partnerships, sales, services, and business operations.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Drive partnership revenue and pipeline: Build and execute partnership strategies that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, accelerate sales opportunities, and expand revenue across Toptal’s services, products, and new businesses.
  • Own strategic partner relationships: Develop joint business plans with priority partners, build executive and field-level relationships, establish shared goals, and lead regular business reviews focused on revenue, pipeline, adoption, and growth.
  • Build joint GTM and co-sell motions: Turn partnerships into actionable sales motions through joint solutions, account mapping, co-selling, marketplace opportunities, reseller programs, sales enablement, campaigns, and events.
  • Grow Toptal’s position within partner ecosystems: Drive certifications, specializations, partnership tiers, designations, marketplace listings, and other requirements that increase Toptal’s access, credibility, benefits, and commercial opportunity within each ecosystem.
  • Secure partner investment: Identify and capture Marketing Development Funds (MDF), sponsorships, enablement funding, event support, sales incentives, and other partner-funded programs that can accelerate growth.
  • Manage the partnership lifecycle: Own partnerships from identification and business case through contracting, onboarding, launch, activation, growth, and ongoing performance management.
  • Coordinate cross-functional execution: Work closely with Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership to ensure partnership commitments are translated into clear owners, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
  • Measure portfolio performance: Establish and track KPIs across revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner engagement, co-sell activity, and partner investment, while maintaining clear visibility into priorities, blockers, and next steps.
  • Build scalable partnership operations: Create the processes, tools, documentation, and operating cadence required to manage a growing partner portfolio efficiently without losing speed or accountability.
  • Stay hands-on in execution: Personally develop partner plans, presentations, applications, business cases, enablement materials, and other work required to move partnerships forward and convert strategy into results.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Build context on Toptal’s partnership strategy, priority partners, current pipeline, and active initiatives.
  • Meet key stakeholders across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and leadership.
  • Begin transitioning ownership of priority partner relationships, operating cadences, and near-term opportunities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a clear view of the partner portfolio, including revenue opportunity, tier status, certifications, GTM motions, and key gaps.
  • Take ownership of partnership priorities, partner engagement, pipeline visibility, and cross-functional execution.
  • Identify immediate opportunities to accelerate co-sell activity, partner-funded programs, certifications, and tier progression.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Establish joint business plans and measurable growth priorities for Toptal’s most strategic partners.
  • Launch or strengthen partner-sourced and partner-influenced GTM motions, including co-selling, account mapping, enablement, marketplace, and joint solution opportunities.
  • Implement scalable processes and metrics for revenue, pipeline, certifications, tier progression, partner investment, and overall portfolio performance.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial impact through partnership-driven pipeline, revenue opportunities, partner activation, and stronger ecosystem positioning.
  • Advance priority partners through certifications, designations, tiers, marketplaces, and other programs that expand Toptal’s commercial opportunity.
  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm across partner planning, executive engagement, pipeline reviews, GTM execution, and performance management.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Build a scalable partnerships function that is a meaningful contributor to Toptal’s revenue growth and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop a portfolio of strategic partners with clear joint business plans, measurable pipeline and revenue impact, stronger partner tiers, and active co-sell motions.
  • Create the systems, relationships, and operating model required to continue expanding Toptal’s partner ecosystem across existing and emerging services, products, and new businesses.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 8+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, alliances, business development, professional services, sales, or related commercial roles, with demonstrated ownership of complex partner relationships.
  • Proven experience developing and executing partnership strategies that have contributed to pipeline, revenue growth, co-sell activity, joint solutions, or market expansion.
  • Experience working with technology, platform, cloud, AI, software, marketplace, or professional services partners is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships across both executive and field organizations and translate those relationships into actionable joint business plans.
  • Experience navigating partner programs, including certifications, specializations, tiers, marketplaces, reseller or co-sell programs, MDF, and partner-funded initiatives.
  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to identify where a partnership can create meaningful value for both Toptal and the partner.
  • Proven ability to operate at both the strategic and hands-on executional levels, including developing plans, presentations, business cases, partner applications, and GTM materials.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to drive execution across Sales, Services, Talent, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Product, and Operations without relying on direct authority.
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using CRM, pipeline management, analytics, and collaboration tools such as Salesforce, Google Workspace, Slack, and AI productivity tools.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.
30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events

jobs.description:
Trainee - Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d)
Intro

Du willst nach dem Studium oder deiner Ausbildung praktisch durchstarten, hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du von Anfang an mit anpackst und wirklich etwas lernst? Dann steig als Trainee Buchhaltung & Office Management (m/w/d) bei uns ein und unterstütze unser Team in Berlin an der Schnittstelle zwischen Buchhaltung, Office Management und CEO Support!Wir empfangen dich in einem Team, das sich gerne neuen Herausforderungen stellt, dich Schritt für Schritt einarbeitet und dir echte Verantwortung überträgt, sobald du dich sicher fühlst.Wir besetzen diese Position zunächst befristet für ein Jahr, da eine Kollegin aus unserem Team für einige Monate eine berufliche Auszeit nimmt. Im Anschluss schauen wir gemeinsam, wie eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit aussehen kann.Idealerweise startest du zum 1. November, damit genug Zeit für eine gute Einarbeitung und Übergabe bleibt.


Deine Aufgaben bei reisetopia

reisetopia ist in den vergangenen Jahren deutlich gewachsen. Als Trainee lernst du dabei nach und nach, worauf es in dieser vielseitigen Position ankommt – ein gutes Auge für Zahlen, Struktur und Prozesse. Du wirst von unserem Team eng begleitet und wächst Schritt für Schritt in folgende Bereiche hinein:

Buchhaltung & Finanzadministration

  • Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Erfassung, Prüfung und Zuordnung von Belegen in Datev
  • Tägliches Monitoring unserer Bankkonten und Zahlungseingänge sowie Pflege unserer Liquiditätsplanung
  • Erstellung von Rechnungen für Partner sowie Provisionsabrechnungen
  • Übertragung und Aufbereitung der BWA in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO
  • Bearbeitung von Reisekostenabrechnungen und Einsammeln von Belegen aus dem Team
Office Management & Unternehmensadministration
  • Organisation von Events und internen Team-Anlässen
  • Verantwortung für Bestellungen (z. B. Büro-/Lebensmittelbestellungen) und allgemeine Maintenance-Themen im Office
  • Pflege interner Unternehmensseiten (u. a. „Über uns", Onboarding- und Mitarbeiterseiten) sowie unserer internen Notion-Wissensdatenbank
  • Sicherstellung regelmäßiger Backups unternehmensrelevanter Daten
  • Weiterentwicklung interner Prozesse und Dokumentationen, damit sich Kolleg:innen im Alltag eigenständig zurechtfinden
CEO Support
  • Ausgefeiltes Kalendermanagement für unseren Geschäftsführer Moritz
  • Vorbereitung von Präsentationen für interne Formate wie unser vierteljährliches Company Update oder Management-Meetings
  • Unterstützung bei allgemeinen Projekten zur Unternehmensentwicklung

Zusätzlich lernst du im Laufe deines Traineeships auch projektbezogene Themen kennen, die für Abwechslung sorgen und dir einen breiten Einblick in die Unternehmensentwicklung geben. Wichtig ist uns vor allem deine Lernbereitschaft – Erfahrung sammelst du bei uns.


Das erwarten wir von Dir

Das zeichnet Dich für diese Position besonders aus:

  • Große Lust, dich schnell und selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten und stetig dazuzulernen
  • Ein gutes Auge für Zahlen und Daten sowie Freude an Organisation
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im (Projekt-)Management oder die Fähigkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu strukturieren, zu priorisieren und voranzutreiben
  • Hohe Flexibilität und Belastbarkeit, um Dich in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Umfeld schnell zurechtzufinden
  • Interesse an Buchhaltungs- und Finanzthemen; erste Berührungspunkte (z.B. aus Studium, Ausbildung oder Praktika) sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel; Vorkenntnisse in Datev, Teams und Notion sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und diskrete Arbeitsweise – insbesondere im Umgang mit vertraulichen Finanz- und Unternehmensdaten
  • Hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse sowie mindestens gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Wünschenswert: Abgeschlossenes Studium oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Bürokauffrau/-mann, Steuerfachangestellte/r) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Ein zusätzliches Plus: erste Erfahrung in einer Assistenz-, Buchhaltungs- oder Office-Management-Rolle sowie Interesse an Finanzen und (Luxus-)Reisen

Grundlegend für alle Stellen gilt bei uns ein Fokus auf Teamarbeit, Spaß an der Sache und Proaktivität. Wir schätzen neue Ideen und fordern Dich bei Deiner Arbeit täglich heraus.


Das erwartet Dich bei reisetopia

Inmitten der Hauptstadtmetropole bieten wir Dir ein junges und agiles Arbeitsumfeld. Als Kernelemente der DNA von reisetopia gestalten flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für Home oder Travel Office den Arbeitsalltag besonders dynamisch.

Für diese Position liegt das Jahresgehalt zwischen 30.000,00 Euro und 35.000,00 Euro brutto, abhängig von Deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation. Die Stelle ist dem Junior-Level zugeordnet.

Wir bieten eine Menge für deinen Einsatz - von einmaligen Teamtrips und außergewöhnlichen Teamevents bis hin zu einmaligen Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in einem rasant wachsendem Unternehmen. Wir empfangen Dich in einer familiären Atmosphäre und bieten eine ganze Reihe an Add-ons, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag verschönern:

  • Beste Arbeitsbedingungen in unserem Büro in der Nähe vom am Potsdamer Platz
  • Deutschlandticket Job oder Job Rad
  • Mittagsessenzuschuss und monatliches Catering
  • Interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in Höhe von 500 Euro im Jahr
  • Kostenfreier Barista-Kaffee sowie verschiedene Kaltgetränke
  • Snacks und frisches Obst
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Möglichkeiten eigene Projekte umzusetzen
  • Cashback für Buchung über suitespot
  • Moderne und einfache Zeiterfassung mit voller Flexibilität
  • Aktive Unterstützung durch kostenlose und anonyme Coachings zur Verbesserung der mentalen Gesundheit
  • Zuschuss zu Deiner Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft
  • Exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte für Shopping, Reisen und vieles mehr
Damit Du unser Produkt auch persönlich kennenlernst, gibt es für Dich zusätzlich zum Start ein kostenloses Wochenende mit reisetopia Hotels Vorteilen im Waldorf Astoria Berlin!

jobs.title: Clinical Training and Education Lead
jobs.description:
Clinical Training and Education Lead

What is the job?

This is an opportunity to shape how our clinical teams learn, develop and perform as Montu continues to grow.

Sitting within the Learning and Development function, you will take ownership of the learning experience across our clinical teams. You will build structured, engaging and practical development programmes that give our people the knowledge, skills and confidence to deliver safe, consistent and patient-centred care.

You do not need to be a clinician or hold a professional healthcare registration. However, you will need to understand the realities of working in a clinical environment, including the importance of patient safety, clinical governance, regulatory compliance and quality.

Working closely with clinical subject-matter experts, operational leaders and the wider People team, you will turn complex standards, processes and clinical requirements into learning that people can understand, apply and embed in their everyday work.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is passionate about developing people, confident working with specialist stakeholders and comfortable building learning solutions in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What You Will Own

Clinical Learning and Development

  • Own the learning and development plan for our clinical teams, ensuring it supports business priorities, service growth and workforce capability

  • Design and deliver structured onboarding, induction and ongoing development programmes for new and existing team members

  • Build clear learning pathways that support employees from joining the business through to continued development and career progression

  • Create engaging workshops, digital learning, practical resources and supporting materials for a range of clinical audiences

  • Conduct training needs analyses, skills audits and capability assessments to identify current and future development priorities

  • Deliver group workshops, virtual learning sessions and one-to-one coaching where required

  • Support the delivery and monitoring of mandatory training and continuing professional development requirements

Competency and Capability

  • Develop clear and practical competency frameworks in partnership with clinical subject-matter experts

  • Create consistent approaches to assessing knowledge, skills and competence across clinical teams

  • Work with managers to identify capability gaps and put appropriate development plans in place

  • Support leaders in embedding coaching, feedback and reflective practice within their teams

  • Ensure learning is transferred into day-to-day performance rather than ending when the training session finishes

Clinical Standards and Governance

  • Work closely with Clinical Governance, Quality, Safeguarding and operational leaders to ensure learning reflects current standards and requirements

  • Translate clinical policies, pathways, Standard Operating Procedures and regulatory requirements into clear and practical learning

  • Support the rollout of new clinical services, systems, technologies and ways of working through effective training and change support

  • Ensure relevant learning supports Care Quality Commission standards, patient safety requirements and internal governance expectations

  • Recognise where specialist clinical input or approval is required and work with the appropriate subject-matter expert

  • Maintain accurate learning, competency and compliance records across clinical teams

Learning Impact and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish clear measures of success for learning programmes and evaluate their impact on capability, performance and service quality

  • Use assessment outcomes, employee feedback, audit findings, quality data, incidents, complaints and patient feedback to identify learning priorities

  • Produce meaningful learning insights and reports to demonstrate progress, risks and areas for improvement

  • Regularly review and improve learning content to ensure it remains accurate, relevant and effective

  • Identify opportunities to improve how learning is delivered, recorded and embedded across the business

  • Champion a culture where learning, coaching, feedback and continuous improvement are part of everyday work

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build credible and trusted relationships with clinical, operational and People leaders

  • Partner with subject-matter experts to create learning that is clinically accurate, engaging and appropriate for its audience

  • Coach and support managers to identify development needs and build capability within their teams

  • Balance learning priorities with operational requirements in a busy and fast-moving environment

  • Act as the Learning and Development lead for relevant clinical change and transformation projects

What do you need?

  • Strong experience within Learning and Development, workforce development, operational training or a similar role

  • A good understanding of clinical or healthcare environments, including patient safety, clinical governance, quality and regulatory requirements

  • Experience designing and delivering engaging learning programmes for specialist, operational or regulated teams

  • Strong learning design skills, with the ability to turn complex or technical information into clear and practical learning

  • Experience developing structured onboarding programmes, learning pathways or competency frameworks

  • Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills

  • The confidence to work with clinical specialists and senior stakeholders without needing to be the clinical expert in the room

  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different teams

  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business

  • Strong project-management and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work through to completion

  • Experience using data, feedback and performance measures to evaluate learning and drive improvement

  • Experience supporting organisational change, service transformation or the implementation of new systems and processes

  • Confidence using learning management systems, digital learning tools and reporting platforms

  • A relevant Learning and Development, education or training qualification would be beneficial but is not essential

  • Professional registration with a healthcare body is a plus, but not required

 

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £45K – £50K

Senior Key Account Executive

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense. Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense. Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing.

  • Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel.

  • Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes.

  • Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes.

  • Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature.

  • Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes.

  • Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs.

  • Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive.

  • Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…).

  • Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique.

  • Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles.

  • Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu.

  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit.

  • Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine).

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires.

  • Tu parles anglais.

jobs.title: Mobile frontend engineering
jobs.description:
Mobile frontend engineering

Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

We’ve processed 200,000+ clinical tests across 4 countries with a team of 20. We’re growing 10% week over week. And we’re still early.

We’re looking for a mobile frontend engineer who treats the app as a craft, not a checklist. You care about the half-pixel, the spring curve on a transition, the way a screen feels in the hand, and you can build it. You own the mobile experience end-to-end in our monorepo, orchestrate AI to execute, and raise the bar for everyone around you.

You won’t spend your days writing boilerplate. You’ll write specs that agents execute, review AI-generated code with a critical eye, and make decisions that compound over time. This is what engineering looks like now. If that excites you, keep reading.

What we’re looking for: Mobile frontend, design engineering & world-class craft

A confirmed mobile engineer (8+ years) with exceptional craft and a real sensibility for design. You live in Expo and React Native, you care deeply about how the product feels, and you don’t wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful. You have also experience building native experience. You think in interactions, motion, and detail.

You’ll own what members touch every day: onboarding, the core app surfaces, the moments that turn a first-time visitor into someone who trusts us with their health. Your work has to be delightful and reliable on real devices, for people who decide in minutes whether to trust us.

 
 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

 

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

  • You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

  • You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

  • You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

  • You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

  • You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

 

We would not be a fit if

  • You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

  • You measure output in lines of code written

  • You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

  • You optimize for stability over velocity

 

Our current stack

TypeScript monorepo · React Native · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

 

The process

  • Intro call (20 min): culture & role fit.

  • Technical interview (30 min)

  • At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

  • Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

  • Reference calls

 

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

 

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: Legal counsel
jobs.description:
Legal counsel

As Legal Counsel, you’ll help shape and build Maki’s legal function. This is a broad, hands-on role spanning commercial contracts, legal operations, privacy, product, regulatory matters, and company strategy.

Your mission is to create a scalable legal function that supports clear rules, fast decisions, and responsible growth. You’ll work closely with Sales, Leadership, Security, Product, and Engineering to turn legal obligations into practical decisions across the company.

What you’ll do

Lead commercial contracting

  • Review, draft, and negotiate customer agreements, including master services agreements (MSAs), data processing agreements (DPAs), security and privacy provisions, and related commercial documentation.

  • Represent Maki in negotiations with customer legal and procurement teams, using sound commercial judgment to determine which requirements to accept, mitigate, or challenge.

  • Help the commercial team understand the practical implications of contractual commitments before they are made.

  • Develop negotiation positions, fallback clauses, and contracting standards that make enterprise contracting more efficient while managing risk.

  • Coordinate with Sales, Leadership, Security, Product, and Engineering to ensure commitments are clear and achievable.

Build scalable legal operations

  • Develop and maintain standard agreements, terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other core legal documentation.

  • Create processes for contract review, approvals, renewals, and legal requests, with clear ownership and decision-making responsibilities.

  • Build templates, playbooks, clause libraries, and internal guidance to help teams handle common legal questions consistently.

  • Select and implement legal tools and workflows as the volume and complexity of legal work grow.

  • Make legal knowledge and contractual obligations accessible to the teams responsible for acting on them.

Advise on product, privacy, and regulation

  • Monitor developments in AI, privacy, employment, data protection, and other regulations affecting Maki and its customers.

  • Translate regulatory and contractual obligations into practical product and operational requirements.

  • Work with Product and Engineering to identify necessary features, controls, workflows, and technical capabilities.

  • Advise the commercial team on how legal requirements affect product positioning, sales, and deployment.

  • Help leadership assess emerging legal risks and make informed strategic and operational decisions.

  • Develop practical policies and processes that meet legal obligations without unnecessarily slowing teams or customers.

What you’ll bring

  • Qualification as a legal counsel in a relevant jurisdiction.

  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements.

  • Strong experience in technology, SaaS, data, privacy, or related commercial legal matters.

  • A practical understanding of GDPR, data protection, and the regulatory environment surrounding technology and AI.

  • Sound judgment in distinguishing material legal and commercial risks from theoretical concerns.

  • The ability to explain legal issues clearly to non-lawyers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • A constructive, commercially minded approach to negotiations with sophisticated customer legal teams.

  • The ability to work independently and build structure where little currently exists.

Nice to have

  • Experience negotiating agreements with large enterprise customers.

  • Experience with AI regulation, employment technology, or enterprise software.

  • Experience building the legal function of a fast-growing technology company.

What success looks like

  • Enterprise contracts move efficiently, with clear commitments and appropriate risk management.

  • Legal documentation, processes, and decision-making practices scale with the company.

  • Teams understand how legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations affect their work and translate them into practical action.

jobs.title: Accounting Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Accounting Automation Engineer

About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are hiring an Accounting Automation Engineer to replace manual accounting work across a multi-entity, multi-country enterprise, using Claude Code and agentic AI.

You will use Claude Code and agentic AI, plus Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end close and the wider day-to-day accounting operation. You need strong IFRS or US GAAP knowledge to get the numbers right, because an automation that posts wrong entries is worse than no automation.

We build agentic AI systems and AI agents, not fixed step-by-step workflows. Experience with rule-based workflow builders such as n8n or Zapier is not relevant to this role.

Titles we will consider: Accounting Automation Engineer, Finance Engineer, Financial Systems Engineer, Technical Accountant (with engineering background), Accounting Systems Manager (with engineering background).

Key Responsibilities

The goal is to automate the repeatable core of enterprise accounting, with human review kept only where judgment is needed.

Accounts payable

  • Invoice capture and data extraction from PDFs and email, using AI where useful

  • Vendor matching, coding suggestions, and 2-way/3-way PO matching

  • Duplicate invoice detection and approval routing

  • Payment run preparation and vendor statement reconciliation

Accounts receivable

  • Invoice generation and delivery

  • Cash application and bank receipt matching

  • Aging reports, dunning and collections reminders

  • Credit note handling and bad debt/ECL provision support

Reconciliations

  • Bank and card reconciliations across all accounts and currencies

  • Balance sheet account reconciliations (prepayments, accruals, deferred revenue, fixed assets)

  • Intercompany and subledger-to-GL reconciliations

  • Exception reports that flag only the items a human needs to review

Month-end close

  • Close checklist tracking and scheduled reminders

  • Recurring, accrual, prepayment and amortization journals

  • Depreciation runs and FX revaluation

  • Trial balance checks, flux/variance analysis, and draft commentary

  • Management reporting packs

General accounting operations

  • Expense report and employee reimbursement checks

  • Chart of accounts and master data hygiene

  • Audit support: evidence collection, PBC lists, sample extraction

  • Data pipelines between ERP, banks, payment platforms and spreadsheets

Qualifications

Two things matter most, and we weigh them above everything else:

  1. Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP

  2. Real experience with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, backed by solid engineering basics

We accept two paths: an accountant who learned to code, or an engineer who learned accounting. Both are judged on the same practical test.

  • Hands-on experience building automations with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (either is fine)

  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, with solid engineering basics, shipping working scripts and agents

  • Ability to run local scripts and schedule jobs (cron, task schedulers or CI pipelines)

  • Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP, shown by ACCA, ACA, CPA or equivalent, or by several years of hands-on accounting experience

  • Experience with core processes: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, month-end close

  • Comfort working with APIs and MCP servers, CSV/Excel data and basic SQL

  • Care for accuracy, controls and audit trails

Nice to have

  • Experience in multi-entity or multi-currency environments, including intercompany and consolidation

  • Experience reconciling payment processor statements across multiple jurisdictions and currencies

  • Experience with shared cost services that invoice group companies, including complex expense splits and automated invoice generation

  • Experience with an ERP and its API (which ERP does not matter)

  • Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool use and MCP servers

  • Knowledge of VAT/GST and e-invoicing rules in several jurisdictions

  • Experience with Git, testing and basic cloud deployment

  • Prior experience in a finance transformation or accounting operations team

  • Additional languages, where our entities operate in non-English markets

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.

  • Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.

  • Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Business Systems Engineer

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

Job Summary

As a Business Systems Engineer on the GTM Engineering team, you will design, build, and operate the automation and AI systems that power ClickUp's Go-To-Market business — spanning core business products and the integration platforms that connect them. This role is AI-native at its core: you won't just maintain existing workflows, you'll actively advance our GTM systems with intelligent agents, LLM-powered automations, and next-generation integration patterns built on MCP, ClickUp Super Agents, and modern iPaaS tooling.

You'll sit at the intersection of business systems architecture and applied AI — partnering with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and fellow GTM Systems engineers to eliminate toil, accelerate revenue workflows, and build the automated, AI-augmented infrastructure the company runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone deeply fluent in enterprise business systems, excited about deploying production AI, and committed to genuine ownership of the platforms they build — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Native Automation & Agent Development

  • Design and build AI-powered automations and agentic workflows across the GTM tech stack — including Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, and MuleSoft — to eliminate manual effort and accelerate business operations.

  • Develop and deploy ClickUp Super Agents and LLM-based automations to automate tasks such as deal data enrichment, quote generation assistance, order validation, revenue recognition triggers, and exception handling in quote-to-cash workflows.

  • Architect and implement MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations that allow AI agents to interact with business systems contextually and safely — enabling intelligent, event-driven actions across the GTM platform.

  • Explore and evaluate emerging AI capabilities (RAG, fine-tuning, multi-agent orchestration) and determine which are production-ready for GTM business systems use cases.

  • Build reusable AI templates, automation patterns, and agent blueprints that can be extended across the GTM Engineering team.

Business Systems Integration & Architecture

  • Build and maintain integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, Workato, MuleSoft, DealHub (CPQ), and other GTM platforms — with a strong bias toward clean architecture, low technical debt, and supportable design.

  • Own end-to-end integration patterns for critical business flows such as lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, order-to-fulfillment, and revenue reporting pipelines.

  • Design data flows and transformation logic that keep business data accurate, consistent, and accessible across systems without creating fragile point-to-point dependencies.

  • Apply a build-vs-buy mindset: evaluate whether a given automation need is best solved with native platform capabilities, iPaaS tooling, or custom code — and make the case clearly.

Platform Development & Tooling

  • Build internal tooling, low-code/no-code solutions, and lightweight applications using platforms such as Retool, Replit, or similar to extend business systems capabilities with minimal overhead.

  • Write automation scripts and data transformation logic in Python, JavaScript, or Apex as needed to bridge gaps that platform tooling cannot address natively.

  • Utilize Zapier, Workato, and similar iPaaS platforms to orchestrate cross-system workflows that are maintainable, observable, and well-documented.

  • Own the full lifecycle of what you build: discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

Reliability, Observability & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor the health and performance of automations and integrations you own; proactively identify degradation, data inconsistencies, or failure patterns before they impact business operations.

  • Conduct root-cause analysis of integration failures or automation breakdowns and drive durable fixes — not just incident patches.

  • Maintain runbooks and operational documentation so that platform behavior is understandable and recoverable by the broader team.

  • Gather feedback from business stakeholders and iterate on existing automations to improve accuracy, reduce edge cases, and adapt to evolving GTM processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Customer Success stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.

  • Work closely with GTM Systems Engineering, DevOps, and BSA teammates on architecture decisions, intake prioritization, and delivery execution.

  • Contribute to the GTM Systems Engineering operating model: maintain task hygiene, communicate proactively on large initiatives, and log AI/automation work in the team's AI Excellence registry.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for business systems automation and AI — educating stakeholders on what's possible and setting realistic expectations on scope and delivery.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in a business systems engineering, systems administration, or integration engineering role.

  • Demonstrated experience building and shipping automations or integrations that delivered measurable business value in production environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and at least one ERP platform (NetSuite strongly preferred).

  • Experience deploying AI or LLM-powered automations in a production business systems context — or a clear, demonstrated trajectory toward it.

  • Experience working in a high-velocity environment where you manage multiple concurrent priorities and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Optional but valued: experience with DealHub (CPQ), ClickUp, quote-to-cash workflows, or revenue operations systems.

Skills & Competencies

Technical

  • Salesforce configuration, automation (Flow, Process Builder), Apex, and data model design — admin or developer-level proficiency required.

  • NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript, SuiteBundler, saved searches, and data model — particularly as it relates to order management, billing, and revenue recognition.

  • Hands-on experience with Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier, or comparable iPaaS platforms — including multi-step flows, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, and MCP integrations. Experience with ClickUp Super Agents is a strong plus.

  • Proficient with Python, JavaScript, or Apex for automation scripting and data transformation; comfortable with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth-based integrations.

  • Strong understanding of business systems data models and integration patterns (event-driven, batch, real-time).

Operational & Mindset

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for the systems you build — from reliability and documentation to stakeholder trust and continuous improvement. You don't hand off and walk away.

  • Velocity: You move fast, iterate, and ship. You know when "good enough and deployed" beats "perfect and blocked," and you never sacrifice reliability or data integrity to get there.

  • AI & Automation mindset: You default to asking "how can an agent or LLM handle this?" before reaching for a manual workflow — experimenting confidently and evaluating critically.

  • Collaboration: You bridge the gap between technical architecture and business impact, asking clarifying questions, challenging assumptions respectfully, and earning trust with the stakeholders you support.

  • Growth: You stay current on emerging AI capabilities, evaluate what's production-ready, and continuously raise the bar on what GTM systems can do.

What You'll Work With

  • Salesforce: CRM platform — automations, Flow, Apex, data model, reporting, and CPQ/OTC integrations.

  • NetSuite: ERP platform — SuiteScript, workflows, order management, billing, and revenue recognition flows.

  • ClickUp Super Agents: AI-powered automation and agentic task orchestration within the ClickUp ecosystem.

  • Integration stack: Workato, MuleSoft, Zapier — recipe/flow development, cross-system orchestration, and platform observability.

  • AI & MCP tooling: LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflow design, and production AI integration patterns.

  • Low-code tooling: Retool, Replit, or similar for internal applications and workflow extensions.

  • Scripting & APIs: Python, JavaScript, Apex, REST/webhook integrations, and JSON-based data transformation.

**METAKI
**Dresden, Germany (TU Dresden) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / AI for Engineering

**About Metaki
**Metaki is building a 'Large Engineering Model' (LEM): a graph-neural-network surrogate trained on large-scale finite element simulation (FEA) data that predicts, near-instantly, how complex 3D parts respond to different materials, loads and boundary conditions — replacing slow FEA runs. The initial focus is solid and structural mechanics, with the long-term ambition of a general foundation model for engineering physics.

**The opportunity
**Founded by Samir El Masri (Founder, ongoing PhD in FEM, 3 years of industry experience in FEM & AI/ML for engineering), Metaki already has a working FEM → data → NN pipeline, is building out a large 3D training dataset, and is running training alongside early industry discussions. What's missing is a technical co-founder to help scale the modeling and engineering work while Samir also drives funding applications and industrial pilot partnerships.

Tasks

**What you will own
**

**Model & platform development
**- Co-own the neural-network surrogate modeling pipeline (FEM data → GNN training → fast inference), extending it from solid/structural mechanics towards a general engineering-physics foundation model.
- Scale the large 3D simulation dataset and physics-informed training infrastructure currently in development.

**Technical leadership
**- Take technical/CTO ownership alongside Samir El Masri (Founder), covering architecture, ML engineering and data pipeline decisions.
- Help turn early industry discussions into validated industrial pilots by making the model production-ready.

**Fundraising support
**- Support funding applications and strategic introductions with a credible technical narrative and roadmap.

Requirements

**What you bring
**

**Core experience
**- Strong machine learning background, ideally with graph neural networks, surrogate modeling, or physics-informed ML.
- Comfort working with finite element simulation data and engineering/physics domain concepts (solid or structural mechanics a plus).

**Especially valuable
**- Software/ML engineering experience taking a research pipeline to a scalable, production-ready product.
- Interest in building toward a general foundation model for engineering physics.
- Experience with industrial pilot partnerships or applied research collaborations.

Benefits

**Why join Metaki
**- A working FEM → data → NN pipeline already built, not just an idea — real technical traction to build on.
- Early industry discussions already underway, with funding applications and pilot partnerships actively being pursued.
- Ground-floor technical co-founder equity in a company aiming to become a foundational-model platform for engineering physics.

Metaki welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

NOCH FRAGEN?

DAS BIETEN WIR

ÜBER UNS

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering (f/m/d)
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende Immoblien-Intelligence-Plattform für ESG und Wert-Management in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.


Deine Mission

Als Head of Engineering übernimmst du die Führung unseres aktuell rund 10-köpfigen Engineering-Teams und baust es weiter aus. Du hilfst deinem Team, ambitioniert zu liefern: kontinuierliche Verbesserungen für unsere bestehenden Kunden, aber auch neue Prototypen und Innovationen, die unser Geschäftsmodell erweitern. Gleichzeitig sorgst du für Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team, damit alle jeden Tag ein Stück besser werden.

Du bist ein starker Sparringspartner und denkst in Systemen: Gemeinsam mit unserem C-Level, dem Product- und Data-Team sowie unseren Kunden entwickelst du unsere Produktstrategie weiter und findest technisch tragfähige, smarte Lösungen. Bei uns gewinnt die beste Idee - egal von wem sie kommt. Mit 40 Leuten gibt's einfach keinen Raum für Politik.

Technisch baust du unsere Architektur so, dass sie mit uns skaliert und Raum für Innovation lässt - etwa bei der Integration von AI-Komponenten und Datenpipelines. Dabei hast du bei uns freie Hand: Neues ausprobieren, den Tech-Stack weiterentwickeln und auch Kapazität für technisches Fundament und Tech Debt einplanen.

So hilfst du auch unseren Sales- und Customer-Success-Teams, neue Kunden zu gewinnen - und baust dir damit deine eigene User- und Fan-Base auf. Und: Jede Zeile Code trägt dazu bei, den CO2-Fußabdruck von Immobilien zu verbessern.

Tech-Stack: TypeScript (Full Stack, React im Frontend, NestJS im Backend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL RDS, AWS ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, Claude


Woran wir Erfolg messen

  • Du holst das Beste aus agentic engineering raus und erweiterst zusammen mit deinem Team die Plattform um eine 360°-Sicht auf die Immobilie.
  • Du hast das Team schneller liefern lassen - indem du es unterstützt, die Can-do-Mentalität stärkst und den Fokus auf die wirklich wichtigen Dinge setzt - bei Produkten und Architektur-Projekten.
  • Du hast das Team um starke Talente erweitert.
  • Du weißt, was jede Person in deinem Team antreibt - und hast ihr geholfen, die eigene Performance aufs nächste Level zu heben.


Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Software-Engineering-Führung und -Architektur, mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Skalieren von Engineering-Teams bei gleichzeitig hoher Shipping-Geschwindigkeit - idealerweise in einem Nicht-Konzernumfeld.
  • Du liebst es, Teams wachsen zu lassen, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu unterstützen und ihnen gleichzeitig ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen.
  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung mit den genannten Frontend- und Backend-Technologien sowie modernen Tech-Stacks - nicht, indem du alles selbst codest, sondern indem du dein Team befähigst.
  • Du denkst in Systemen und löst Probleme konsequent aus einer First-Principles-Perspektive.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau bzw. C1 und fließend Englisch.


Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.

  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Was du hier aufbaust - Team, Architektur, ein Produkt, das Kunden wirklich nutzen - bleibt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar: im Revenue, im Produkt und darin, wie das Engineering-Team in einem Jahr arbeitet.

  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.

  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.

  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 4 Tage/Woche.

Dann bist du bei BSI goldrichtig!

  • Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, führst Root-Cause-Analysen durch und bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Observability ein. Als Teil des Teams bist du Anlaufstelle für interne Teams, Kunden und Partner und übernimmst im Turnus die 2nd-Level-Support-Bereitschaft und Rufbereitschaft

  • Du entwickelst unser Monitoring mit Prometheus und Grafana aktiv weiter, erstellst aussagekräftige Dashboards und Alerts und sorgst dafür, dass potenzielle Probleme frühzeitig erkannt werden

  • Du automatisierst den Aufbau und die Verwaltung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Terraform und sorgst mit ArgoCD, Docker und CI/CD dafür, dass neue Anwendungen zuverlässig und automatisiert auf Kubernetes bereitgestellt werden

  • Du sorgst für sichere und widerstandsfähige Systeme, entwickelst Backup- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepte weiter und stellst deren Praxistauglichkeit regelmässig auf die Probe

  • Du hältst unsere Runbooks und Betriebsdokumentation aktuell, optimierst wiederkehrende Abläufe und automatisierst, was nicht manuell erledigt werden muss.

Wir suchen Macher

  • Abgeschlossene Lehre, 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Gebiet 

  • Breite Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Security, Virtualisierung, Container (Docker/Kubernetes)

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools (Ansible, Terraform) und Skriptsprachen (Bash, Python)

  • Neugier, effizientes Arbeiten und unternehmerisches Denken

jobs.title: Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
Engineering Intern

About Us

We are The Robotics Company, building the infrastructure that enables robots to be deployed at scale.

In just six months, we’ve grown from $0 to $1M in revenue, driven by strong demand for what we’re building. We’re backed by leading investors, researchers, and operators across AI and robotics, including Dr. Marc Pollefeys, the founder of Hugging Face, SV Angel, and leaders from Google DeepMind, Google Cloud, Scale AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, and more.

Our mission is to build the foundational infrastructure that brings intelligent robots out of the lab and into the real world.

About the Internship

We’re looking for exceptional students who are excited to work at the intersection of robotics, AI, and real-world deployment.

As an Engineering Intern, you’ll work directly alongside our research and engineering teams on meaningful technical problems, contribute to systems running on real robots, and gain hands-on experience building at an early-stage robotics company.

Depending on your background and interests, you may work across robot learning, computer vision, 3D perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics software and infrastructure.

What You’ll Do

  • Work alongside our researchers and engineers to develop and test robotics and AI systems.

  • Contribute to projects across robot learning, perception, manipulation, navigation, simulation, or robotics infrastructure.

  • Prototype, implement, and evaluate new algorithms and technical approaches.

  • Test software and models in simulation and on real robotic systems.

  • Take ownership of a meaningful technical project with direct mentorship from the team.

What We Look For

  • Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, AI/ML, Computer Vision, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++.

  • Hands-on experience through robotics projects, research labs, internships, competitions, or open-source work.

  • We especially love candidates with experience in leading robotics and research labs, including SLAM, RAI, Boston Dynamics, and similar environments.

  • Familiarity with PyTorch, JAX, ROS/ROS2, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar frameworks is a plus.

  • Strong technical curiosity and excitement about solving difficult problems in robotics.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment.

We care more about what you’ve built, explored, and learned than checking every box.

If you’re excited about building intelligent robotic systems that operate in the real world, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Facility Security Officer
jobs.description:
Facility Security Officer

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is hiring a Facility Security Officer to build and manage our industrial security program as our federal business grows. You will serve as Cribl’s appointed FSO of record with the Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), own the Facility Clearance (FCL) program, and support compliance with the National Industrial Security Program and 32 CFR Part 117.

This is an industrial-security role—not a guard or general office-security position. You will partner with Legal, People Operations, Contracts, Public Sector Sales, IT, Workplace, and Security & Compliance.

We’re looking for a Sr Security & Compliance Engineer to join our team!


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Manage FCL sponsorship and maintenance in NISS, including SF-328, KMP designations, changed conditions, and FOCI reporting.
  • Manage the cleared-personnel lifecycle in DISS/NBIS, including sponsorship, investigations, reinvestigations, continuous vetting, transfers, debriefings, and terminations.
  • Guide applicants through eApp and maintain accurate, confidential personnel-security records.
  • Deliver initial, annual, insider-threat, foreign-travel, and other required security briefings.
  • Review and maintain DD Form 254s, process visit authorizations, and advise Contracts and Legal on security requirements before commitments are made.
  • Conduct annual self-inspections, prepare required certifications and reports, maintain corrective actions, and lead preparation for DCSA Security Reviews.
  • Serve as Cribl’s primary point of contact with DCSA and the trusted advisor to executives and cross-functional teams on government security requirements.
  • Partner with Workplace and Facilities on access control, visitor management, secure-area requirements, and other facility controls applicable to cleared work.
  • Establish and maintain security policies, procedures, records, and training programs.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. Government Secret clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain Top Secret.
  • 7+ years of industrial- or personnel-security experience, including 3+ years as an appointed FSO or Assistant FSO at a cleared contractor.
  • Working knowledge of 32 CFR Part 117 and the NISPOM.
  • Hands-on experience with DISS/NBIS, NISS, eApp, FCL processing, SF-328/FOCI, DD Form 254s, self-inspections, and DCSA Security Reviews.
  • Completion of the applicable DCSA/CDSE FSO curriculum through STEPP, or the ability to complete it within six months of appointment.
  • Experience standing up a security program or taking a facility through an initial FCL.
  • Strong writing, communication, organization, discretion, and judgment.
  • Ability to work effectively across a distributed, remote-first organization.
  • Preferred Skills
    • Experience in a commercial software, SaaS, cloud, or technology company.
    • SPēD or NCMS ISP® certification.
    • Familiarity with ITPSO responsibilities, FedRAMP, CMMC, DFARS, or CUI requirements.
    • Familiarity with Cribl products or observability technologies.

#LI-Remote

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.
